title: Full-Stack Developer, AI Products (Next.js, Python, Supabase)
description:
WHO WE ARE

Nexus Digital is a digital transformation partner based in Melbourne, Australia, started by two brothers, Ryan and Cooper Lanyon. We help established businesses grow and maximise the productivity of their teams, without needing extra headcount, by building AI systems into their processes and workflows. We build everything with Claude Code, and we want someone who works the same way.



WHAT WE DO

- Workshops: hands-on AI workshops where business owners build working tools with us in the room

- In-person training: teaching teams to use and run AI in their day-to-day work

- Full custom builds: AI systems built into a company's operations. Assistants connected to their
, CRM, project tools and data, live dashboards, daily briefings, and automations that take hours of manual work off a team every week

- Ongoing support: we maintain and extend everything we build, so it keeps getting better month after month



We don't build demos or chatbots. Our systems run in production on servers we set up and secure ourselves, with approval steps on anything risky, and the client owns everything we build.



WHO WE WORK WITH

Established Australian businesses, typically 10 to 50 staff, in industries like transport and logistics, health, media and professional services, plus business owners who come through our workshops.



WHAT'S HAPPENING RIGHT NOW

- We just ran our first AI workshop with 16 business owners in the room, and it has already turned into partnerships

- We've partnered with a Melbourne brand agency whose clients' products sit on the shelves of Australia's biggest supermarkets. We're the AI team behind their campaigns

- We've partnered with an NDIS provider (Australia's disability support sector), and together we're launching our first software product, built to roll out to providers right across the country in a sector worth nearly $50 billion a year

- There's a pipeline of businesses lined up behind that, waiting for us to build for them



WHERE WE'RE HEADED

We're on a mission to help 1,000 Australian businesses implement and adopt AI, then train their teams to run it. We're growing faster than the two of us can build. Over the next few years we want Nexus Digital to be the name Australian businesses think of when they want AI that actually works in their operations, with our own products, a big client book and a full team of engineers delivering it. You would be the first engineer on that team, getting in on the ground floor. As it grows, the person in this seat is the one we want leading builds, setting the standards, and helping us hire the people who come next.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT

- You work directly with the two founders, not through layers of management

- Real client and product work from your first few weeks, not tickets on a backlog nobody reads

- The newest tooling every day: Claude Code, MCP servers, AI agents running in production

- A long-term, full-time role, with a pay review at 90 days and a bonus on every project delivered clean

- Room to grow into a lead role as the team grows



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build dashboards and websites in Next.js, deployed on Vercel

- Build the Python services and AI features behind them

- Connect business tools through their APIs

- Write tests and clear docs so non-technical people can use what you build

- Over time, own client builds end to end



YOU'VE DONE

- Claude Code as your daily tool: you plan the work, steer it, and review everything it writes before it ships

- Next.js or React apps that real users use

- Python or Node backends with Postgres or Supabase

- At least one feature built on an LLM API (Claude or OpenAI)

- Clear written and spoken English



NICE TO HAVE

MCP servers, Linux servers, n8n



HOW WE WORK

- Systems over experiments. If it doesn't run reliably every day, it isn't finished.

- Security is part of the job. Our clients trust us with their business data, and we treat it that way.

- Clear over clever. Everything we build should make sense to the person who uses it.

- Honest over hype. If something won't work, we say so before we build it.

- A quick daily check-in with us on Slack, fast answers when you're stuck, and real ownership of your work.



TERMS

Full-time, 40 hours a week, 10am to 6pm Melbourne time (7am to 3pm Manila). USD 1,300 a month to start (negotiable) depending on experience, reviewed at 90 days, plus a bonus on every project delivered clean.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word FULLSTACK.

2. In two or three lines, tell us how you use Claude Code day to day.

3. After you apply, we'll message you a short intro video from our co-founder and ask for a 2 to 3 minute video back. We only move forward with people who send one.

title: AI Automation Developer (Python, n8n, API Integrations, claude code)
description:
WHO WE ARE

Nexus Digital is a digital transformation partner based in Melbourne, Australia, started by two brothers, Ryan and Cooper Lanyon. We help established businesses grow and maximise the productivity of their teams, without needing extra headcount, by building AI systems into their processes and workflows. We build everything with Claude Code, and we want someone who works the same way.



WHAT WE DO

- Workshops: hands-on AI workshops where business owners build working tools with us in the room

- In-person training: teaching teams to use and run AI in their day-to-day work

- Full custom builds: AI systems built into a company's operations. Assistants connected to their
, CRM, project tools and data, live dashboards, daily briefings, and automations that take hours of manual work off a team every week

- Ongoing support: we maintain and extend everything we build, so it keeps getting better month after month



We don't build demos or chatbots. Our systems run in production on servers we set up and secure ourselves, with approval steps on anything risky, and the client owns everything we build.



WHO WE WORK WITH

Established Australian businesses, typically 10 to 50 staff, in industries like transport and logistics, health, media and professional services, plus business owners who come through our workshops.



WHAT'S HAPPENING RIGHT NOW

- We just ran our first AI workshop with 16 business owners in the room, and it has already turned into partnerships

- We've partnered with a Melbourne brand agency whose clients' products sit on the shelves of Australia's biggest supermarkets. We're the AI team behind their campaigns

- We've partnered with an NDIS provider (Australia's disability support sector), and together we're launching our first software product, built to roll out to providers right across the country in a sector worth nearly $50 billion a year

- There's a pipeline of businesses lined up behind that, waiting for us to build for them



WHERE WE'RE HEADED

We're on a mission to help 1,000 Australian businesses implement and adopt AI, then train their teams to run it. We're growing faster than the two of us can build. Over the next few years we want Nexus Digital to be the name Australian businesses think of when they want AI that actually works in their operations, with our own products, a big client book and a full team of engineers delivering it. You would be the first engineer on that team, getting in on the ground floor. As it grows, the person in this seat is the one we want leading builds, setting the standards, and helping us hire the people who come next.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT

- You work directly with the two founders, not through layers of management

- Real client and product work from your first few weeks, not tickets on a backlog nobody reads

- The newest tooling every day: Claude Code, MCP servers, AI agents running in production

- A long-term, full-time role, with a pay review at 90 days and a bonus on every project delivered clean

- Room to grow into a lead role as the team grows



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Turn manual business processes into automations that run every day

- Connect CRMs,
, calendars and project tools through their APIs and webhooks

- Move workflows from no-code tools into Python when they outgrow them

- Write tests and clear docs so non-technical people can use what you build

- Over time, own client builds end to end



YOU'VE DONE

- Claude Code as your daily tool: you plan the work, steer it, and review everything it writes before it ships

- Automations a real business relies on, in n8n, Make or Zapier, and in code

- Python scripts or services against REST APIs

- An LLM API (Claude or OpenAI) used inside a workflow

- Clear written and spoken English



NICE TO HAVE

MCP servers, Supabase, Linux servers



HOW WE WORK

- Systems over experiments. If it doesn't run reliably every day, it isn't finished.

- Security is part of the job. Our clients trust us with their business data, and we treat it that way.

- Clear over clever. Everything we build should make sense to the person who uses it.

- Honest over hype. If something won't work, we say so before we build it.

- A quick daily check-in with us on Slack, fast answers when you're stuck, and real ownership of your work.



TERMS

Full-time, 40 hours a week, 10am to 6pm Melbourne time (7am to 3pm Manila). USD 1,200 a month to start (negotiable)  depending on experience, reviewed at 90 days, plus a bonus on every project delivered clean.



HOW TO APPLY

title: AI Systems Engineer (Claude Code, Python, API Integrations)
description:
WHO WE ARE

Nexus Digital is a digital transformation partner based in Melbourne, Australia, started by two brothers, Ryan and Cooper Lanyon. We help established businesses grow and maximise the productivity of their teams, without needing extra headcount, by building AI systems into their processes and workflows. We build everything with Claude Code, and we want someone who works the same way.



WHAT WE DO

- Workshops: hands-on AI workshops where business owners build working tools with us in the room

- In-person training: teaching teams to use and run AI in their day-to-day work

- Full custom builds: AI systems built into a company's operations. Assistants connected to their
, CRM, project tools and data, live dashboards, daily briefings, and automations that take hours of manual work off a team every week

- Ongoing support: we maintain and extend everything we build, so it keeps getting better month after month



We don't build demos or chatbots. Our systems run in production on servers we set up and secure ourselves, with approval steps on anything risky, and the client owns everything we build.



WHO WE WORK WITH

Established Australian businesses, typically 10 to 50 staff, in industries like transport and logistics, health, media and professional services, plus business owners who come through our workshops.



WHAT'S HAPPENING RIGHT NOW

- We just ran our first AI workshop with 16 business owners in the room, and it has already turned into partnerships

- We've partnered with a Melbourne brand agency whose clients' products sit on the shelves of Australia's biggest supermarkets. 

- We've partnered with an NDIS provider (Australia's disability support sector), and together we're launching our first software product, built to roll out to providers right across the country in a sector worth nearly $50 billion a year

- There's a pipeline of businesses lined up behind that, waiting for us to build for them



WHERE WE'RE HEADED

We're on a mission to help 1,000 Australian businesses implement and adopt AI, then train their teams to run it. We're growing faster than the two of us can build. Over the next few years we want Nexus Digital to be the name Australian businesses think of when they want AI that actually works in their operations, with our own products, a big client book and a full team of engineers delivering it. You would be the first engineer on that team, getting in on the ground floor. As it grows, the person in this seat is the one we want leading builds, setting the standards, and helping us hire the people who come next.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT

- You work directly with the two founders, not through layers of management

- Real client and product work from your first few weeks, not tickets on a backlog nobody reads

- The newest tooling every day: Claude Code, MCP servers, AI agents running in production

- A long-term, full-time role, with a pay review at 90 days and a bonus on every project delivered clean

- Room to grow into a lead role as the team grows



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and extend our AI systems in Python, using Claude Code

- Connect business tools through their APIs: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits

- Set up and maintain the Linux servers these systems run on

- Write tests and clear docs so non-technical people can use what you build

- Over time, own client builds end to end



YOU'VE DONE

- Claude Code as your daily tool: you plan the work, steer it, and review everything it writes before it ships

- Python that runs unattended in production, not just notebooks

- Real work against an LLM API (Claude or OpenAI): tool use, structured output, handling failures

- Linux, SSH and Git day to day

- Clear written and spoken English



NICE TO HAVE

MCP servers, Supabase or Postgres, n8n, Next.js



HOW WE WORK

- Systems over experiments. If it doesn't run reliably every day, it isn't finished.

- Security is part of the job. Our clients trust us with their business data, and we treat it that way.

- Clear over clever. Everything we build should make sense to the person who uses it.

- Honest over hype. If something won't work, we say so before we build it.

- A quick daily check-in with us on Slack, fast answers when you're stuck, and real ownership of your work.



TERMS

Full-time, 40 hours a week, 9am to 5pm Melbourne time. USD 1,200 a month to start  (negotiable) depending on experience, reviewed at 90 days, plus a bonus on every project delivered clean.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word SYSTEMS.

2. In two or three lines, tell us how you use Claude Code day to day.

3. After you apply, we'll message you a short intro video from our co-founder and ask for a 2 to 3 minute video back. We only move forward with people who send one.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About PHNYX Group



PHNYX Group is a venture studio with operations in Dubai, Switzerland and China. We partner with founders to build, scale and exit ecommerce brands.

Our founder has built multiple brands, including PHNYX Watches, which has done millions in revenue. He shares what he knows with a fast-growing audience of entrepreneurs.



Why this role exists

Our founder films a lot of content. What we need is someone who makes sure we show up every day, from feed to stories, no matter what is happening that week.

You turn content into a daily plan, keep at least a week ready for both accounts at all times, and turn followers into leads for our offers.





What you will own

Cutting and posting Reels on 2 Instagram accounts every day: 4 Reels and 2 carousels a day on our founder's main account, and at least 3 Reels and 2 carousels a day 





Daily stories, including a weekly promo cycle that brings people into our offers

A content bank that always has 7+ days of approved posts and stories for both accounts

ManyChat keyword flows that rotate between our offers and our newsletter, with every lead tagged in GHL

Replying to comments and DMs on Instagram and YouTube, and passing leads to our setters right away

Cross-posting to 
 and
 when it fits

A weekly report: what was posted, what worked, how many leads came in

What success looks like

After 90 days:

Not one day missed



7+ days of content always ready for both accounts

Leads coming in from stories and DMs every week

More of the right audience: entrepreneurs aged 31+ in Tier 1 countries

Who we are looking for

Someone who never lets a day go by without posting. Someone who sees a comment from a potential client and replies before anyone asks.





You understand that the goal is not just views. It is the right people, and turning them into leads.

Compensation

$800/month to start, paid via PayPal or card payment (not bank transfer). Paid at the end of each month for the first 4 months, then on the 15th and the last day of each month.

Rises to $1,200/month once we close $100,000 in a week from Instagram leads



4-week paid probation

You start with 4 paid weeks of real work on our accounts. If it goes well, you move to a month-to-month contract.



How to apply

1. Subject line: "SMM - [Your Name]" (we use this to check attention to detail)

2. Links to Instagram accounts you managed, with what you personally did

3. Screenshots of growth from Instagram insights

4. One story sequence you made that led to sales or leads

5. A Loom video, 3 minutes max, introducing yourself

6. Your answers to these application questions:

Each question asks for specifics that are hard to fake. Vague answers score low.

>> Which Instagram accounts have you run? How long, and what did YOU do each day?

>> What is the longest streak of daily posting and stories you kept going? Have you posted 4+ Reels a day on one account? What system did you use to keep up?

>> Share a story sequence you made that brought in leads or sales. What happened, with numbers?

>> Have you built ManyChat flows? Describe one, step by step.

>> The founder hasn't filmed in 10 days. What do you post this week?

>> A comment says "How much is your program?" What do you reply, and what happens next?

>> How would you make sure our audience is entrepreneurs aged 31+ with buying power, not just views?

>> Look at our founder's Instagram. Name one thing you would change first and why.

>> Can you work 5 hours in Dubai working hours and 4 hours in US Eastern hours, 5 days a week, plus a 30-minute check each weekend day? Yes or no.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer with a front-end focus to join our client's growing engineering team.



This is a hands-on role for an engineer who is comfortable working across the stack and taking ownership of features from start to finish. While the role has a strong front-end focus, we're looking for someone who is comfortable contributing beyond the UI and working across backend services, integrations, and supporting systems.



You'll work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to turn requirements and ideas into reliable, high-quality software. You'll have the opportunity to contribute not only to how features work, but also to how they look, feel, and work for the end user.



This role is well suited to an engineer who combines strong technical skills with product thinking, design awareness, and good judgement.







Key Responsibilities

Full-Stack Software Development



Design, develop, test, and maintain software across the front-end and backend.

Own features end to end, from understanding requirements and planning through development, testing, deployment, and refinement.

Build reliable, maintainable, and performant software.

Contribute to backend services, APIs, integrations, and supporting systems.

Work closely with Product and Design to translate requirements and concepts into high-quality technical solutions.

Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across the application stack.

Contribute to improving the reliability, performance, and maintainability of existing systems.

Front-End Development & Product Experience



Build polished, intuitive, and responsive user experiences.

Translate UX/UI concepts and mockups into production-ready features.

Apply strong product and design judgement rather than simply implementing designs pixel for pixel.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, clarity, consistency, and the overall user experience.

Make thoughtful improvements while respecting agreed requirements, scope, timelines, and other fixed constraints.

Balance technical quality, user experience, and practical delivery requirements.

Backend & Systems Development



Develop and maintain backend services and supporting systems.

Build and maintain APIs, integrations, scheduled processes, and other technical components as required.

Ensure software is robust, performant, scalable, and maintainable.

Contribute to reliable deployment processes and cloud-based infrastructure.

Investigate and resolve technical issues across the application stack.

Support ongoing improvements to existing systems, processes, and technical workflows.

Product Delivery & Prioritisation



Work with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to understand priorities and deliver against requirements.

Prioritise critical functionality and ensure key requirements are delivered first.

Recognise when additional polish or enhancements can be addressed after core functionality is delivered.

Flag blockers, risks, dependencies, and potential delivery issues early.

Communicate proactively about progress, challenges, and anything that may affect delivery.

Take ownership of assigned features and see them through to completion.

Make practical decisions that balance product quality, technical considerations, and delivery requirements.

Team Collaboration



Participate in planning sessions, code reviews, technical discussions, and other engineering activities.

Collaborate closely with Product and Design to ensure technical solutions meet both functional and user experience requirements.

Share ideas and propose technical improvements to existing systems and workflows.

Contribute to a positive, collaborative, and accountable engineering environment.

Be responsive, reliable, and easy for teammates to work with.

Communicate clearly and respectfully with team members and stakeholders.





Other Responsibilities



Make necessary process suggestions and improvements which can help the team.

Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.

Perform other related tasks and duties that may be assigned by the client later on.



About You

We're looking for an engineer who combines strong technical capability with product thinking, design awareness, ownership, and good judgement.



Essential Experience & Skills



2–4 years of professional Software Engineer experience.

Strong full-stack development experience with a front-end leaning.

Solid background in software development and system design.

Experience building and shipping modern web applications.

Experience working across both front-end and backend systems.

Experience working with modern programming languages, cloud infrastructure, and deployment environments.

Experience working closely with Product and Design teams to bring requirements and product ideas to life.

Strong understanding of modern front-end development practices.

Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of priorities and delivery requirements.

Ability to own features end to end and work independently.

Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Ability to identify and communicate blockers early.

Product & Design Mindset

What sets the right person apart is a strong product and design eye. You should be able to take a mockup and make it noticeably better instead of copying it pixel for pixel, while still treating copy, legal, scope and deadlines as fixed.



You should understand how to prioritise delivery effectively — shipping what's critical for go-live first and polishing later where appropriate.



You should also be proactive in your communication: flag blockers early and be easy to reach when collaboration or decisions are needed.



Personal Attributes



Product-minded and genuinely interested in how software works and feels for the end user.

Strong eye for detail and quality.

Practical and outcome-focused.

Comfortable making thoughtful decisions when requirements are fixed but there is room to improve the implementation.

Able to distinguish between what is critical for go-live and what can be refined later.

Proactive in raising blockers and risks.

Reliable, responsive, and accountable.

Easy to reach and easy to work with.

Collaborative and respectful when working with Product, Design, and Engineering teammates.

Comfortable working independently while keeping relevant stakeholders informed.

Takes ownership and follows through on commitments.





What You'll Bring



The ideal candidate is a full-stack engineer who leans front-end and enjoys having meaningful ownership over the products they build.



You'll bring strong engineering fundamentals along with an appreciation for product quality and user experience. You won't simply implement a mockup exactly as provided — you'll understand the intent behind it and use your own product and design judgement to make the end result better, while respecting the requirements and constraints that cannot change.



Most importantly, you'll be someone the team can rely on — proactive in communication, quick to flag blockers, easy to reach, accountable for your work, and comfortable taking ownership of a feature from idea through to production.

title: Marketing Operations & Social Media Manager
description:
Department: Marketing 

Reports to: Creative Director 

Work Type: Remote



Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Marketing Operations & Social Media Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our creators' social media accounts.

This role focuses on ensuring content is organized, scheduled, published consistently, and tracked accurately. You will coordinate with editors and the marketing team, maintain content calendars and trackers, monitor account health, and prepare performance reports.

The ideal candidate is proactive, reliable, comfortable managing multiple accounts, and able to identify operational issues before they affect the team's workflow.



Key Responsibilities

- Social Media Management & Publishing

- Manage assigned social media accounts and maintain consistent posting schedules.

- Maintain content calendars and schedule posts through Vista Social.

- Check scheduled posts for gaps, failed uploads, and drafts awaiting publication.

- Manage post queues, recurring slots, and posting schedules across profiles.

- Use recommended posting times and follow each account's assigned strategy.

- Submit content for approval, follow up on pending reviews, and ensure only approved content is published.

- Monitor account connections and troubleshoot publishing issues.



Content Organization & Google Drive Management

- Keep Google Drive folders, content libraries, captions, and posting materials organized.

- Track available content and identify gaps in the content pipeline.

- Ensure videos and images are properly labeled, tagged, and organized.

- Check for duplicate or recently published content before scheduling.

- Share content links with relevant team members for review and feedback.

- Editor Coordination

- Assign editing tasks and provide clear instructions based on the team's content plan.

- Track editing progress, pending revisions, and delivery deadlines.

- Follow up with editors on outstanding work.

- Review edited content for technical quality, formatting, hooks, and audio.

- Coordinate revisions and ensure approved content is ready for scheduling.

- Keep editing trackers and content statuses updated.



Metrics & Performance Reporting

-Collect and update creator metrics from Vista Social and Inflow every Tuesday for the Creative Director to review

-Track reach, impressions, engagement, followers, profile visits, post counts, and new subscribers.

-Verify data accuracy and maintain reporting spreadsheets.



Account Maintenance & Technical Operations

-Monitor social media account connections and publishing access on Vista Social

-Monitor account status in GeeLark virtual phones and follow approved account-maintenance and warm-up procedures.

-Escalate account restrictions, disconnections, and technical issues to the appropriate team member.



Team Administration & Coordination

-Maintain task trackers, deadlines, approval statuses, and operational documentation.

-Assign tasks and reviewers according to brand and team responsibilities.

-Maintain brand-specific posting schedules, time zones, and account access permissions.

-Coordinate with editors, marketing team members, and other relevant stakeholders to keep deliverables on track.

- Provide daily updates on completed work, pending tasks, blockers, and issues.

- Follow up proactively on overdue tasks and unresolved operational issues.



Daily Responsibilities

- Check scheduled posts, publishing queues, and account connections.

- Identify posting gaps, failed uploads, and content awaiting approval.

- Update content calendars and task trackers.

- Follow up on pending edits, revisions, and deliverables.

- Coordinate with the team on urgent issues and deadlines.

- Send a daily update covering completed work, pending items, and blockers.



Weekly Responsibilities

- Every Tuesday: Update creator metrics using Vista Social and Inflow.

- Review posting consistency

- Audit upcoming schedules and identify content gaps.

- Follow up on outstanding edits and approvals.

- Review account health and flag technical issues.

- Ensure content calendars and libraries are ready for the upcoming week.



Required Skills & Qualifications

- Experience managing multiple social media accounts.

- Familiarity with social media scheduling and analytics tools, preferably Vista Social.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Experience maintaining content calendars, trackers, and Google Drive folders.

- Ability to coordinate with editors and follow up on deadlines.

- Basic understanding of social media metrics and performance reporting.

- Strong written communication and documentation skills.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and flag issues proactively.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote team environment.



Key Performance Expectations

- Social media posts are scheduled and published consistently according to approved calendars.

- Content calendars, libraries, and trackers remain accurate and up to date.

- Editing tasks and approvals are followed up on promptly.

- Weekly metrics are submitted accurately and on time.

- Account issues and publishing failures are identified and escalated promptly.

- Daily updates clearly communicate progress, pending tasks, and blockers. -

- Operational tasks are completed without requiring constant follow-up from the Creative Director.



What Success Looks Like

The Marketing Operations & Social Media Manager keeps the team's day-to-day execution organized and running smoothly. The Creative Director can focus on strategy, creative direction, and creator growth because publishing, tracking, coordination, and routine operational

follow-ups are being handled reliably.

title: Experienced Bookkeeper for Australian Accounting Practice
description:

We are offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Bookkeeper with a solid background in the bookkeeping environment and proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Xero. Join our growing team and deliver high-quality results by following clearly documented systems in a supportive and efficient workplace.  

Experience with Australian GST is essential. 

Join a values-driven accounting team with extra Easter leave available, and a two-week Christmas shutdown!

 #  Clear communication

Your application
 must have the exact subject line:  “Bookkeeper Superstar -  ”

* Process Improvement: Share recurring questions, common player objections, and lead trends with the core team to refine messaging and conversion rates.

description:
🚀 AI Ad Editor — Heritage Health (DTC Supplement Startup)



(PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE THING)



Quick context: Heritage Health is a supplement brand for women’s hormones. Brand new product, real startup — we’re doing under $10k a month right now, and the goal is to build this into a 9-figure brand. You’d be getting in at the very beginning, before it blows up.



This is a ground-floor seat at a brand being built from zero. I’m looking for one hungry, young operator to build the creative engine with me — not a 9-to-5 hire, a partner for the journey. If you live in the online money world and you’ve been waiting for the right brand to go all-in on, this is it.



Who you are:



20–28, young but proven. You’ve already got real reps — you’ve worked with ecom brands and shipped ads that actually ran — but you’re still hungry and have everything to prove.

You don’t just edit — you tell stories. You can take a script and bring it to life. Not just cut clips together, but keep people watching and know exactly which visual goes where so the ad holds attention from the first second to the last.

You’re creative and smart — you think outside the box. I don’t want to hold your hand. I want someone who moves with speed and intent, figures things out, and comes to me with ideas instead of waiting to be told what to do.

You’re obsessed with the online money space. You follow Iman Gadzhi, Brez, TJR, and you understand the business models, not just watch the content.

You know ecom cold. You’re tapped into the brands winning right now — Resilia, Lymphoria, Ryze, IM8 — and you can break down why their ads work.

You’re a killer editor and an AI-ads native. You know Higgsfield and the current stack, and you can produce scroll-stopping AI ads and AI UGC — static, b-roll, Pixar-style, AI singing UGC, all of it. You know what makes a good ad, not just a pretty one.

You’re plugged into the real DR world — Evolve, Origins, and the marketing brands setting the standard right now.

You want to change your life. You’re ready to put your head down and grind — 12+ hour days behind the laptop, locked in with a team of people who want it just as bad, building something real from scratch.



Now the part I care about just as much:



I’ve hired people before who killed it on paper and then disappeared. Took a full day to answer a message. Moved slow. Weren’t hungry. Didn’t take it seriously. I’m done with that. I need someone who messages back fast, who’s genuinely willing to put in 12+ hour days, who replies, moves fast, and treats this like it’s theirs. If you’re lazy, if you ghost, if you need to be chased — don’t apply.



And I don’t just want an editor behind a screen. I want someone cool — someone whose whole personality isn’t editing. Someone I actually want to build with, because the plan isn’t to sit in a room forever. I want to grow a team, go on trips, throw team parties, and live this online money thing to the max. We grind hard first, but the whole point is to build a life worth having.



What you get: This is a startup, and I take care of the people who take care of the brand. When you help us win, I make sure you win — bonuses every time you make a winning ad, higher pay as you prove you’re elite, all of it. There’s no ceiling here. If you print, you get paid like it, and you grow as the brand grows.



If you want to change your life, outwork everyone, and help take a brand from under $10k a month to 9 figures — this is your shot.



And straight up — if you don’t fit all of these requirements, don’t waste my time and don’t waste your time.

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
Growth Marketing Specialist



About eXpand AD

eXpand AD is a growth marketing agency serving B2B businesses across the United States and Canada. We help businesses generate qualified leads, acquire customers, and strengthen their digital presence.





Position Overview

The Growth Marketing Specialist manages content marketing, GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM operations, lead generation, and sales execution for eXpand AD and its clients. The role also includes social media management, reporting, and basic website support.



Key Responsibilities



1. Content Marketing and Social Media

Produce at least 5 complete content packages per week for eXpand AD and its clients.

Develop content concepts and calendars aligned with client briefs, brand guidelines, target audiences, and marketing objectives.

Create copy, graphics, carousels, short-form videos, captions, and calls to action.

Adapt approved content for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

Use Canva and AI tools to support content production.

Schedule and publish approved content; monitor reach, engagement, clicks, inquiries, and leads where measurable.

Support WordPress publishing and basic SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO).

Maintain organized content files and publication schedules.

Content package definition: One campaign-ready deliverable containing the relevant concept, copy, creative assets or video, captions, and calls to action as appropriate. Repurposing the same package across platforms does not count as an additional package. Five packages is the weekly minimum, not a maximum.



2. GoHighLevel CRM and Automation

Maintain accurate contacts, lead sources, pipeline stages, tasks, and follow-up dates.

Manage opportunities from initial lead entry through closed-won or closed-lost status.

Configure and maintain approved workflows, calendars,
 sequences, and basic automations.

Investigate failed actions, duplicate messages, and missed follow-ups.

Ensure active opportunities have a documented status and next step.

Update CRM records within one business day of relevant activity.

Improve pipeline visibility, automation reliability, and follow-up processes.

Support approved client CRM tasks within the assigned scope.



3. Sales and Customer Acquisition

Research businesses and decision-makers in the United States and Canada.

Build targeted prospect lists and conduct personalized outbound outreach through approved channels.

Qualify prospects based on business fit, need, authority, timing, and budget where ascertainable.

Manage follow-ups, book discovery meetings, handle objections, prepare approved proposals, and close deals within delegated authority.

Track sales activity, proposals, opportunity outcomes, customer acquisition, and revenue through GoHighLevel.

Analyze lost opportunities and recommend improvements to outreach and conversion.



Monthly sales target: 10 new paying customers.

A completed deal means a new customer purchasing an approved eXpand AD service, recorded in GoHighLevel and verified under the company's sales process. Leads, meetings, and proposals alone do not count. Performance will be assessed in context of lead availability and quality, offer competitiveness, sales-cycle length, resources, and timely commercial approvals.



4. Reporting and Coordination

Submit one consolidated weekly report covering content output, measurable performance, CRM activity, qualified leads, meetings, pipeline progression, closed deals, revenue where available, blockers, and next steps.

Maintain accurate records and communicate issues promptly.

Follow approved client communication and campaign procedures.

Obtain approval before committing to pricing, proposals, discounts, campaigns, or other external commercial commitments.

Flag capacity constraints and deadline risks promptly.



Work Prioritization

The role is limited to 20 hours per week. Unless otherwise directed, priorities are:

Scheduled content deliverables and urgent client commitments.

Active sales opportunities, follow-ups, and meetings.

CRM accuracy, pipeline maintenance, and automation reliability.

Website support and other improvements.

The specialist must communicate competing deadlines and capacity constraints promptly.



First 14 Days

The initial 14 days focus on onboarding, understanding company services and target customers, learning brand standards, verifying system access, and establishing an actionable sales pipeline.



Expected activities:

Complete onboarding and review services, target audiences, and sales materials.

Review existing marketing assets, calendars, brand guidelines, and client requirements.

Verify access to GoHighLevel, WordPress, Canva, AI tools, and other required systems.

Establish a content production and publishing schedule.

Begin producing at least 5 complete content packages per week.

Review the sales pipeline, identify follow-up opportunities, and begin prospecting.

Verify CRM data quality and identify workflow issues.

Submit weekly progress reports.

The manager will review progress at day 14 and agree on subsequent priorities. Initial performance will account for onboarding, access, lead availability, approval turnaround, and sales-cycle length. The ongoing target of 10 new paying customers per month remains the commercial objective.



Required Qualifications

At least 2 years of marketing, growth, or related experience.

At least 2 years of direct sales experience, including prospecting, qualification, follow-up, and closing.

Practical GoHighLevel CRM and sales-pipeline experience.

Professional English suitable for client calls with US and Canadian businesses.

Working knowledge of Canva, WordPress, and AI productivity or content tools.

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, or equivalent applications.

Ability to create content for multiple platforms and follow brand guidelines.

Strong communication, organization, and independent execution skills.

Evidence of personal contribution to previously closed sales deals.

Ability to meet the agreed schedule independently.



Languages

English: Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Additional languages: French, Spanish, Arabic, and German are advantageous. Applicants should specify their proficiency levels.



Working Terms

Location: Remote; international applicants welcome.

Contract: Part-time freelance.

Rate: US$4/hour, up to 20 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM US Eastern Time. Applicants must verify local working hours.

Payment: Monthly in USD for approved hours worked. Payment method, invoicing, approval process, and payment date will be specified in the freelance agreement.

Additional hours: Require prior approval.

Tools and expenses: Required company accounts and resources will be specified. No subscriptions or expenses may be incurred on behalf of the company without prior written approval.

Future opportunity: Full-time work may be considered based on performance, business needs, and budget; it is not guaranteed.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit:

Resume or professional profile.

Short introduction describing relevant experience.

Examples of personally closed deals, including role, approximate value, and contribution.

Evidence of practical GoHighLevel experience.

Relevant marketing portfolio or work samples.

Earliest available start date.

Confirmation of acceptance of the hourly rate and schedule.

Languages spoken and proficiency levels.

Redact confidential client information. Do not submit passwords or private customer data.



Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates will participate in a structured interview covering content production, GoHighLevel, sales experience, English communication, office-suite proficiency, additional languages where relevant, availability, and evidence of previous work and personally closed deals.



Performance Management

-

- Instagram

- Threads

- LinkedIn

- TikTok

- X 
)

, and YouTube Shorts when applicable.

- Escalate questions or complaints that require management or specialized assistance.

- Monitor brand mentions and relevant conversations.

- Maintain a positive and professional online presence for Rate DNA.

- Follow company guidelines regarding NMLS information, Equal Housing Opportunity requirements, disclosures, licensing information, and advertising language.

- Review content for compliance before publishing.

- Work with management/compliance personnel when clarification or approval is required.

- Stay informed about company-specific marketing and compliance requirements.

8. Analytics & Reporting

- Monitor social media performance across platforms.

- Track key metrics including:

- Engagement

- Followers and audience growth

- Reach and impressions

- Website traffic

- Leads generated

- Messages and inquiries

- Content performance

- Prepare a monthly social media performance report.

- Identify top-performing content and opportunities for improvement.

- Provide recommendations based on data and performance trends.

9. Continuous Improvement

- Research new social media features, tools, automation opportunities, and emerging platforms.

- Recommend new tools or workflows that can improve efficiency.

- Test new content formats and strategies.

- Continuously improve Rate DNA's social media presence and lead-generation process.

- Stay current with changes to platform algorithms, policies, and best practices.



Required Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in social media management, digital marketing, or a related role.

- Strong experience managing multiple social media platforms.

- Experience creating social media content, graphics, and short-form videos.

- Experience with social media scheduling and management platforms.

- Strong understanding of social media marketing and audience engagement.

- Experience with automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or similar platforms.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Excellent written English and communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to troubleshoot basic technical and automation issues.



Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of mortgage and real estate advertising compliance.

- Experience with NMLS and Equal Housing requirements.

- Experience with CRM platforms and lead-routing systems.

- Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, or similar creative tools.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

- Automation-minded and always looking for ways to eliminate repetitive manual work.

- Creative and able to produce engaging content.

- Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.

- Detail-oriented, especially when managing multiple accounts and automations.

- Organized and capable of maintaining a clear content calendar and workflow.

- Analytical and able to use data to improve performance.

- Reliable and responsive when managing comments, messages, and leads.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be evaluated based on:

- Successful setup and optimization of all required social media accounts.

- Consistency and quality of social media content.

- Growth in followers and engagement.

- Increase in reach and brand visibility.

- Number and quality of leads generated.

- Response time to comments and inquiries.

- Successful implementation of automation workflows.

- Reduction in repetitive manual social media tasks.

- Accuracy of lead routing and CRM updates.

- Compliance with company and industry advertising requirements.

- Timely and accurate monthly reporting.



Working Relationship

The Social Media Manager will work closely with management, marketing, sales, and other team members to ensure that social media activity supports Rate DNA's overall marketing and lead-generation goals.

The successful candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of the social media ecosystem—from account setup and branding to content creation, automation, engagement, lead routing, analytics, and continuous optimization.

title: Junior/Senior OSINT Analyst
description:
Sentinel Investigations is a licensed Australian investigations firm. We run investigations for corporate, legal and insurance clients using our own case management platform, SentinelOps. We are building a remote analyst team in the Philippines and are looking for people who want a long-term role in investigations, not a short-term VA job.



You will do open source research on people, companies and assets for active cases. Each task comes with a clear brief. Your Account Manager reviews all of your work before it reaches the client and handles your onboarding, admin, pay and day-to-day support.



What you will do



Research individuals and companies across social media, news, public records, business registries and court listings

Confirm identity by linking accounts, aliases, addresses and associates, and separating real matches from people with the same name

Search for adverse media, business interests, directorships and signs of assets or lifestyle

Capture every finding with screenshots, URLs and timestamps so it can be checked later

Write short, factual findings in SentinelOps, stating how confident you are in each one

Flag anything urgent or outside the brief to your Account Manager straight away



All collection is passive and lawful. You will never contact a subject, use fake identities to engage with anyone, or access private or restricted accounts.



What we need:



At least 2 years in OSINT, fraud investigation, KYC/AML, trust and safety, threat intelligence or investigative research

Excellent written English. Your reports are the product.

Attention to detail and patience.

Comfort handling sensitive and sometimes distressing information with complete discretion

Your own computer, a stable internet connection of at least 25 Mbps, a backup connection, and a quiet private workspace

Willingness to provide two professional references.



Nice to have



Experience with Australian, US or UK public records

Experience with link analysis tools such as Maltego or i2

Languages other than English and Filipino



Hours and pay



Full time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 6:00am to 3:00pm Manila time (9:00am to 6:00pm Sydney time).



Pay is ₱35,000 to ₱55,000 per month depending on experience, plus 13th month pay. There is a pay review after 6 months and a clear path to Senior Analyst. Room for negotiation for Senior Analysts with a proven track record. 



How to apply



Send your CV and a short cover note (under 200 words) covering:



Your investigation or research experience

One example of something you found online that others missed, and how you found it



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short written test, then an interview with a 3 month probation. We ask that you do not use AI tools to write your application. We want to see how you write.

This is a daily recurring role that requires consistency, attention to detail, and the ability to follow SOPs carefully.



About Us



We are DB Duo, a growing e-commerce company running multiple Shopify stores in home decor and lighting across the US, UK, and Europe.



We’re scaling from 3 to 10 stores in the coming months and are expanding our team. You’ll work closely with our CS Manager and join a small, driven team that values ownership, speed, accuracy, and clear communication.



What You’ll Do



* Export orders daily from the Shopify ParcelPanel app

* Update and maintain our shipping/tracking sheet accurately

* Check parcel tracking through 17Track, YunExpress, ParcelsApp, and other relevant tracking platforms

* Review the latest tracking information and identify orders that require action

* Take the correct action based on each parcel status, including:

  * In Transit

  * Pick Up

  * RTS / Return to Sender

  * Info Received

  * OOS / Out of Stock

  * Lost In Transit

  * Delivered

  * Failed Delivery

  * Other shipping exceptions



Who We’re Looking For



*Extremely accurate and detail-oriented — small mistakes can have big consequences

* Reliable and consistent with daily recurring tasks

* Able to work independently and stay focused on repetitive tracking work

* Strong written English for customer communication when required

* Comfortable following SOPs and taking the correct action based on each situation

* Organized and confident working with spreadsheets

* Able to identify inconsistencies or unusual tracking activity

* Responsible and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks

* Comfortable communicating with the team when clarification or escalation is needed

* Previous experience with e-commerce, order tracking, logistics, or customer support is a plus

* Familiarity with Shopify, ParcelPanel, 17Track, YunExpress, ParcelsApp, Gorgias, Google Sheets, and Slack is an advantage



What We Offer



* Clear SOPs, trackers, and training, so you know exactly what’s expected

* A direct and supportive team where your input matters

* Steady, recurring work with room to grow

* Direct collaboration with the CS Manager and a small, driven team



How to Apply



Send us:



1. Your CV, or a short overview of your previous e-commerce, logistics, order tracking, or customer support experience

2. A list of the tools you’ve worked with — for example Shopify, ParcelPanel, Gorgias, 17Track, Google Sheets, etc. — and how long you’ve used each

3. A short video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and telling us why you’re a great fit for this role.



*Applications without a video will not be considered.*



⚠️ Important: Start your video by saying the words “DB Duo.”



This tells us you’ve read the full job post and can follow instructions carefully.



We’re looking for someone who is precise, dependable, organized, and committed to getting the details right. If you’re someone who notices the small things and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Order Issue & Dispute Specialist – Shopify Fashion Store
description:

Wattle & Reed is an Australian women's fashion brand selling online through

Shopify. We are a small remote team that works together in Slack. Our customer

support is handled by a dedicated VA. This role handles what happens behind

it: orders that go wrong and payment disputes.



THE ROLE

This role has two parts: supply chain and disputes. We prefer one person who

does both, but you can also apply for one of the two.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Supply chain

- Check open and unfulfilled orders and tracking every day

- Chase our supplier on stuck shipments until they are resolved

- Handle out-of-stock items

- Check the supplier's invoice

- Tell our customer support VA which
s to send to customers



Disputes

- Check new chargebacks and inquiries in Shopify every day

- Submit the evidence before the deadline

- Contact the customer to resolve the case

- Send a weekly dispute report



WHAT WE ARE ACTUALLY LOOKING FOR

- Experience as an e-commerce virtual assistant, ideally for a Shopify store

- Supply chain: experience with dropshipping or overseas suppliers

- Disputes: experience with chargebacks or payment disputes

- Good written English

- Available every day, including weekends, in short blocks

- Reliable communication. Mistakes are fine.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term role. We want someone who grows with us: as the store grows, so

  do your hours, your responsibilities and your pay.

- USD 3 per hour, open to discussion, tracked in Hubstaff

- Monthly bonus based on results

- Part-time. We discuss the hours on the call.

- Direct line to the founder



HOW TO APPLY

Apply with the subject line "Wattle & Reed - Orders & Disputes" and tell us

which part you are applying for: both, supply chain only or disputes only.



If you follow these instructions, we send you a short application form

(10 to 15 minutes). At the end, the form asks for the link to a 1-minute

video in which you tell us your why: what drives you, and why you want this

role. Upload it to YouTube (unlisted), Loom or Google Drive or just e-mail it and make sure

anyone with the link can view it.

title: Guest Experience Assistant for Iceland Guesthouse (Customer Service)
description:
We are a small guesthouse in Iceland, close to Reykjavik, looking

for one person to take care of our guests from before they book

until after they leave. This is a long-term, fully remote role.



Most of our guests are couples and solo travellers from Europe and

the US coming to see Iceland for the first time. They arrive

excited and slightly nervous. Your job is to make sure that by the

time they land, everything is already sorted.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call and message guests before their trip to help with airport

  transfers, car hire, and day tour suggestions

- Answer guest questions by WhatsApp and
. An AI assistant

  drafts many of the replies, and you check, correct, and send them

- Keep our booking system and guest records accurate

- Check competitor pricing and flag what we should change

- Suggest improvements to our online guest information

- Write a short daily report



Once the routine is running well, there is room to take on

marketing, revenue, and project work.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Reliability above everything. You finish what you start, and you

  say so early when something goes wrong.

- Excellent spoken English. You will be on the phone with guests

  every day, so this matters more than written English.

- Genuine care about whether someone has a good holiday

- Stable internet with a backup connection

- Available for a fixed daily schedule. Our hours follow Iceland,

  which means your working day falls in the late afternoon and

  evening Philippine time. Please only apply if this suits your

  life long term.



FAVOURABLE, NOT REQUIRED

- Experience hosting on Airbnb, or working at a hotel or guesthouse

  front desk

- Any background where you dealt with guests or customers directly



We will train everything else. Our supervisor in Iceland has been

with us for fifteen years and is Filipina, so you will have someone

to learn from who understands exactly where you are coming from.



WHAT WE OFFER

- A long-term position. We are not looking for short-term help.

- Six hours a day, six days a week

- Training, and a pay review once you are settled in the role

- Real responsibility. You will own the guest relationship.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word SKYR so I know you read this

properly.



Then tell me, in a few sentences:

1. A time you helped a guest or customer who was stressed or

   unhappy, and what you did

2. Your internet speed and what your backup is if it goes down

3. Whether the evening schedule genuinely works for you



Applications that skip these will not be read.

title: Customer Operations Dispatcher
description:
Dropcurb is a growing U.S. junk-removal marketplace. We are hiring a dispatcher to help coordinate customers, pickup providers, quotes, and active orders.



This is a fast-moving role, but being fast is not enough. We are looking for someone who is careful, responsible, customer-focused, and willing to verify information before making decisions.



Our biggest requirement is simple: do not guess.



If something does not look right, stop, check the information, ask questions, or escalate it.

Customer Operations Dispatcher



Remote - Philippines

Full-Time

U.S. Hours



Responsibilities:



Respond to customers and pickup providers



Handle and prioritize incoming quotes



Monitor active and upcoming orders



Review order details, photos, messages, and completion proof



Help verify that the correct items were picked up before approving completion



Request additional photos or information when something is unclear



Help resolve active pickup issues



Keep customers updated when there is a problem



Escalate unusual, high-risk, or unclear situations



Follow company procedures carefully



Maintain accurate notes and order information



Provide professional, natural English communication to U.S. customers



Customer experience is extremely important to us.



If Dropcurb makes a mistake, we do not blame the customer, the pickup provider, or another employee. We take ownership, apologize when appropriate, explain what we are doing to fix it, and make sure the customer is taken care of.



We are looking for someone who:



Has excellent written and spoken English



Pays close attention to detail



Cares about customers



Can work quickly without becoming careless



Is comfortable asking questions when unsure



Takes responsibility for mistakes



Does not become defensive when receiving feedback



Can prioritize several urgent tasks at once



Has good common sense and judgment



Can stay calm during busy periods



Learns from mistakes and does not repeat them



Is reliable and consistent



You are not a good fit if:



You regularly guess when information is unclear



You rush through important decisions



You blame other people when something goes wrong



You are careless with customer issues or money



You become defensive when corrected



You repeatedly make the same mistakes



You need constant supervision



You care more about closing a task than making sure it was handled correctly



Schedule:



Approximately 9 PM to 7 AM Philippines time, 6 days per week.



Exact schedule may vary depending on team coverage.



To apply, please send:



Your relevant work experience



Your current or most recent monthly compensation



Your expected monthly compensation



Your availability and earliest start date



Please also answer this scenario:



A customer messages:



“Your hauler picked up the wrong item and left the item I actually paid you to remove.”



Write the exact response you would send to the customer.

Each week you will also deliver a custom thumbnail and, if requested, one or two short vertical clips cut from the main video for YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.



Style references

Please study these two channels before applying. We want our videos to match their pacing and polish.

• Market updates: Tom Storey (YouTube). Clear, data-driven talking-head videos. Tight cuts with no dead air, clean charts and stats on screen, and a strong hook in the first 30 seconds.

• House tours: Mark Salerno (Salerno Realty). Smooth, cinematic walkthroughs with steady pacing, colour grading, music that suits the home, and clean text for key features.



Community updates should blend the two: Tom Storey's clarity with Mark Salerno's visual quality.



Responsibilities

Editing

• Cut raw footage into a tight, engaging 15–30 minute video, removing pauses, mistakes and filler.

• Add b-roll, drone footage, music, sound design and colour correction.

• Build on-screen graphics: charts and stats for market updates, and address, price and feature callouts for house tours.

• Add Team Rajpal branding, including logo, intro, outro and contact details.

• Add accurate English captions.



YouTube channel support (when needed)

• Upload videos to our channel with titles, descriptions, tags and chapters.

• Upload thumbnails, add end screens and cards, and organise playlists by format.

• Schedule videos to publish at our set weekly time.

• Keep the channel tidy and consistent, and flag anything that needs our attention.



Requirements

Must have

• Excellent written and spoken English. You must catch errors in captions and on-screen text without being told.

• A portfolio of long-form YouTube videos (15+ minutes), ideally including real estate or talking-head content.

• Experience editing for the Canadian market, or the attention to detail to learn our standards (see below).

• Able to deliver within 24 hours of receiving footage.

• Experience uploading to and managing a YouTube channel, including titles, descriptions, thumbnails, playlists and scheduling.

• Professional editing software, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

• Reliable, responsive communication during Toronto business hours (Eastern Time).



Nice to have/BONUS

• Experience editing real estate content for Canadian agents.

• Motion graphics skills in After Effects or similar.

• YouTube SEO and thumbnail design skills.



Editing for the Canadian market

Our audience is Canadian buyers and sellers, so every video must look and sound Canadian, not American. Use this table as your checklist.



If you are unsure whether something is Canadian, ask before publishing.

Turnaround and weekly workflow

We aim for a first cut within 24 hours of sending footage, and a final version within 24 hours of our feedback.

1. Team Rajpal shares raw footage, notes and any listing or market data through Google Drive.

2. You deliver the first cut and a draft thumbnail within 24 hours.

3. We send one round of consolidated feedback.

4. You deliver the final video, thumbnail and any short clips within 24 hours.

5. If YouTube support is part of your role, you upload and schedule the video.

Tell us in advance about any days you are unavailable, so we can plan around them.

How to apply

Please send:

• Links to 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you edited, ideally real estate or talking-head content.

• Your rate per finished 15–30 minute video, and any monthly rate for four videos.

• Confirmation that you can meet a 24-hour turnaround, and your working hours in Eastern Time.

• A short note on your experience managing YouTube channels.

• One sentence on how editing for a Canadian audience differs from a US audience.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete one paid test edit.

I need an experienced dropshipping VA to build the store from scratch and run daily operations. You'll handle almost everything. I approve final decisions on products, suppliers, and budget. This is a long-term role for the right person.

title: Social Media Assistant
description:
Social Media Assistant (AI-Savvy) – Viral Research, Reels & Carousels for a Growing Faceless Brand | 20 hrs/week | Results-Based





PLEASE READ THIS FIRST



This is a serious role in a serious business. We are building Family Care Plan into a major brand, and this position is the engine of it. If you are looking for easy hours, a side gig you can ignore, or a job where nobody checks the work, please do not apply. We respect your time and ask you to respect ours.



We review results every single week. People who deliver, communicate honestly, and keep improving will be kept, given raises, and given more responsibility as we grow. People who don't will not be retained.



Honesty matters more to us than perfection. It is always better to tell us "I don't know how to do this" or "I'm going to be late" than to pretend and waste everyone's time.



If that sounds like you, keep reading. We'd love to meet you.





ABOUT US



Family Care Plan 
 is a faceless brand on Instagram, TikTok, and
 for adult children caring for an aging parent, often while working full-time, living far away, or raising their own kids.



Our founder has 10 years of hands-on experience as a home health aide in the United States. Our page teaches the practical side of caregiving: getting organized, coordinating the family, handoffs, and hard conversations. We sell a digital product (a printable care organizer), and we are building toward more products, partnerships, and more pages.



The topic is meaningful. Our followers are tired, stressed, and doing their best for their parents. Our content has to be useful, calm, and kind.





THE ROLE



You'll find what goes viral, figure out exactly why it works, and turn it into calm, useful Reels and carousels for our audience, then post them across all three platforms.





SCHEDULE AND PAY



- 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday (20 hours a week). Weekend posts are scheduled in advance.

- You must be available for 1 hour within an agreed daily window (for example, 7:00–8:00 PM Philippine time) for questions and approvals.

- Starting rate: $4 USD per hour, paid weekly or every two weeks, always on time.

- Paid trial first, at the same rate.

- Raises: $5/hour at 30 days and $6+/hour at 90 days if you consistently meet the weekly review targets.

- Performance bonuses for big results (for example, a Reel passing 100K views, or strong growth in
 sign-ups or sales).

- Long-term, ongoing work. As we grow, this role can grow into more hours, full-time, and leading content for the brand.





WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY DAY (about 4 hours)



1. Viral research (30 min)

Find outlier posts (500K+ views, or far above an account's normal) in caregiving, aging parents, the sandwich generation, family organizing, and related niches. Track 20+ competitor pages. Log every outlier in our Idea Base spreadsheet: link, views, hook, format, pillar, and why it worked.



2. Reverse engineering

Break each outlier down: the hook in the first 1–3 seconds, on-screen text, number of cuts, length, loop ending, and what makes people share or save it.



3. Reels (about 1.5 hours)

Edit 2 Reels a day in CapCut from our template: a strong text hook over calm, licensed stock B-roll, with captions, brand fonts, colors, and logo. 15–45 seconds each. Source clips from Pexels, Pixabay, and the Canva library.



4. Hooks and captions (30 min)

Write 3 hook options per Reel for the owner to choose from. Draft captions with Claude or ChatGPT, then edit them so they sound human, warm, and natural.



5. Posting (20 min)

Schedule approved posts across Instagram, TikTok, and
 at our best times. Post Stories.



6. Engagement (20 min)

Reply to simple comments using our approved templates. Flag anything emotional, sensitive, or medical to the owner. Check daily that our "comment CARE" automation is working.



7. Carousels (from week 3)

Design checklist and script carousels in Canva from our templates.





EVERY WEEK



- Trial Reels (once unlocked): post as a trial first, then to the main feed, and test different hooks.

- Repost proven winners at 90 and 180 days.

- Help coordinate 1 collab post a week with other caregiving pages (the owner approves partners).

- Weekly report and review (included in your hours): top 5 posts by shares, saves, and follows; what to double down on; what to drop; follower,
, and sales numbers; and next week's ideas.





HOW THE WEEKLY REVIEW WORKS



Every week we score your work out of 25 on five things: delivery on time, quality, following the rules, results, and communication.



- 20–25: On track. Eligible for raises and bonuses.

- 15–19: You'll get clear written feedback with 1–2 specific fixes.

- Under 15, or two weeks in a row under 20: Final review. If the next week doesn't improve, the engagement ends.

- A serious rule violation, or missing 2+ delivery days without notice, ends the engagement immediately.



In the first month, we judge delivery, quality, and rules most. Growth numbers carry more weight after day 30, because new pages take time to grow.





OUR NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES



- Faceless content only. No AI-generated people or AI avatars, ever.

- Licensed stock footage only. Never download or repost other creators' videos, TV, or movie clips.

- We remake proven formats with our own hook and angle. We never copy anyone's video, script, or caption word for word.

- No medical advice, ever: no symptoms, medications, doses, fall or transfer instructions, or diet advice.

- Nothing goes live without the owner's approval.

- We never share passwords. You'll get access through Meta Business Suite, a scheduler with team access, a shared Google Drive, and a Canva team.

- Everything you create for Family Care Plan belongs to the business and stays confidential.





YOU MUST HAVE



- Proven experience editing short-form video in CapCut (Reels or TikToks)

- Strong Canva skills

- Comfortable with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and able to edit their output so it sounds human

- A real understanding of how Reels and TikToks get reach: hooks, watch time, shares, and saves

- Excellent written English

- A reliable computer, stable internet, and a backup plan for outages (mobile data, power bank, or a backup location)

- Honesty, reliability, and the ability to take feedback and apply it





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience running or working on faceless or theme pages

- Experience with Meta Business Suite, Metricool or another scheduler, ManyChat, or Beehiiv

- Experience in health, family, or wellness niches

- Personal experience caring for a family member





WORK STANDARDS



- Reply to messages within 12 hours on workdays.

- Tell us at least 24 hours ahead if a deadline is at risk. No surprises.

- Give 48 hours' notice for time off, and 2 weeks' notice if you plan to leave.

- Track your hours honestly.

- Check every post before submitting: spelling, captions, timing, and branding.

- Always be kind and respectful to our followers. Never argue, mock, or use sarcasm.

- Bring at least 1 new idea or format to test every week.





HOW TO APPLY

(Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed.)



1. Start your application with the word "CARE" so we know you read everything.



2. Send links to:

- 3 Reels or TikToks you edited

- 1 carousel you designed

- An example of viral research, or a breakdown of why a post performed well



3. Answer these questions in your own words (please don't use AI for these):



a. Walk us through exactly how you'd find 5 viral posts in the caregiving niche this week. Which tools and searches would you use?



b. Pick any viral Reel you've seen recently. In 5–6 lines, explain why it went viral.



c. How do you use AI for captions without sounding robotic? Show one example edit.



d. How would you post to our Instagram, TikTok, and
 without ever having our passwords?



e. Someone comments, "My mom keeps falling at night, what should I do?" How do you handle it?



f. What's the difference between remaking a viral format and reposting someone's content?



g. If a Reel gets very few views in 24 hours, what would you check and change next time?



h. Are you available 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, with a 1-hour daily overlap in the evening Philippine time? What's your backup plan for power or internet outages?





NEXT STEPS



Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid trial: research 3 viral posts, make 2 Reels and 1 carousel from our materials, and write hooks and captions. The trial is paid whether or not you're hired. The best trial gets the job.



We're building something big and meaningful. If you're serious, honest, and ready to grow with us, we'd love to hear from you.
