title: Reddit Account Operations | $5 per Accepted Account + Post Commission
description:
We are hiring an experienced Reddit account preparation and maintenance specialist. We provide the accounts, authorized systems/tools, target subreddits and category-specific written requirements. You do not need to buy accounts, proxies or software. This is not an account buying/selling role.



PAYMENT — PLEASE READ FIRST

- USD 5 per completed account that meets the agreed requirements and passes acceptance. This is outcome-based work, not an hourly position.

- After account delivery, ongoing approved posting assignments earn a separate commission per successfully published and accepted post. The per-post rate is discussed privately and confirmed before work starts.

- If an account is banned during preparation or before acceptance, no account-preparation fee is payable, including time spent. You do not reimburse us, pay a penalty or provide a free replacement. Report the issue promptly and stop work on that account pending instructions.



ACCOUNT PREPARATION AND ACCEPTANCE

- Assignments normally use a 7–10 day preparation window. Before each batch, we agree on the starting account status, target subreddits, required outcome, deadline and acceptance evidence.

- Each account has a specified delivery level: comment-ready OR post-ready in the assigned subreddits. Commenting eligibility does not satisfy a post-ready brief. Different categories have different requirements; there is no universal karma or account-age target.

- Participation must be genuine, relevant and permitted by current community rules. Flag any conflict between a brief, community restriction and deadline before starting; do not bypass restrictions.

- Provide concise activity logs and public-visible links/screenshots proving the agreed result. A submission button or content visible only to its author is not enough. The account must be accessible, not banned and meet the brief at acceptance.



ONGOING MAINTENANCE AND POSTING

Continued maintenance and approved posting are part of this role, not just a one-off handover. Follow the assigned plan, check current subreddit rules, report restrictions/removals and keep accurate records. Prepare approved posts, make agreed copy revisions and publish only as authorized.



Before each posting batch, we agree on maintenance duties, content, acceptance checks and verification period, commission, and included revision/reposting limits. Routine maintenance within that batch is covered by its per-post arrangement; standalone maintenance or extra scope is agreed separately. There is no unlimited free maintenance or revision obligation.



A commissioned post must match the brief and rules, be publicly visible in the designated subreddit and pass the agreed acceptance check. Failed, filtered/removed or author-only submissions do not qualify. Edits, retries and permitted replacements for the same assigned post earn one commission when accepted, not duplicate fees, unless separately approved. Report removals first; revise or repost only with approval and where permitted. Never switch accounts or repeatedly repost to evade moderator decisions.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- 3+ years of hands-on Reddit experience, including managing 20–30 accounts concurrently and long-term account maintenance. Experience maintaining accounts for 6+ months is especially relevant.

- Practical knowledge of subreddit commenting and posting eligibility, current Reddit policies and how to check rule changes.

- Strong English, reliable communication, honest reporting, organized logs and secure use of company-provided browser environments and authorized access.



No spam, coordinated voting, fabricated customer experiences, fake reviews, unsolicited bulk DMs, automated mass account creation or ban evasion.



HOW TO APPLY

Start with REDDIT-OPS and give short, specific answers:

1. Your years of Reddit experience, maximum accounts personally managed at once, and evidence of long-term results. Include a redacted SOP or activity-log sample you are authorized to share.

2. One subreddit example: explain its commenting versus posting requirements and where you check the latest rules. Briefly outline your approach to a 7–10 day assignment.

3. Your availability and realistic batch capacity. Confirm acceptance of USD 5 per completed, accepted account, the banned-account terms and ongoing per-post commission arrangement.



Do not send passwords, verification codes, customer personal data or confidential client information. Clearly label newly created samples.

title: Reddit Sales & Growth Specialist | $2-$5 per Verified Order
description:
We are looking for a strong, hands-on Reddit sales and growth operator who can turn useful community participation into verifiable customer orders. You should be able to research communities, write persuasive content, run permitted campaigns, handle replies and improve sales conversion — not just generate posts, karma, views or leads.



COMPENSATION — COMMISSION-BASED

- USD 2–5 per verified, attributable customer order generated through your Reddit work. This is not an hourly writing job and has no hourly salary or guaranteed order volume/income.

- The exact rate within this range, eligible products, attribution method, validation process and payout schedule are agreed before each campaign begins.

- We may use approved tracking links, codes or another agreed method. Only genuine completed orders confirmed through that process qualify. Cancelled, refunded, fraudulent or duplicate orders are excluded; the same order cannot be counted twice.



REDDIT ACCOUNTS PROVIDED

We provide Reddit accounts and authorized access. You do not need to bring or buy accounts. You may optionally use compliant accounts you own or are explicitly authorized to operate, subject to advance agreement and community rules. Owning accounts is not required, and the agreed per-order rate does not change based on account source. Do not share personal passwords or credentials in your application.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Find relevant subreddits, buying-intent discussions and customer problems; build a practical Reddit-to-purchase plan.

- Check each community's current posting, commenting, promotional and moderation rules before acting.

- Write, publish and improve useful posts and comments; answer product questions accurately and disclose commercial relationships where required.

- Run authorized subreddit/community operations, discussions, events and marketing activities where permitted. Where relevant, help operate our own subreddit.

- Guide genuinely interested users to the approved product page, website or private community only when appropriate, permitted and consent-based.

- Track activity through to verified orders, test copy and calls to action, report what converted and improve unsuccessful campaigns. Coordinate with our account-operations team.

- Use AI for research or drafting where helpful, but personally check facts, product claims and final copy.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- At least 3 years of practical Reddit marketing, growth or community-operations experience.

- Real Reddit sales results backed by redacted order/attribution evidence you are authorized to share. Engagement or karma screenshots alone are not sufficient.

- Strong English copywriting, audience research, subreddit operations and conversion judgment.

- Reliable records and honest reporting. Clearly distinguish views, clicks, enquiries and leads from completed orders, and confirmed causes from assumptions.



Campaigns may cover AI, e-commerce, SaaS, pets, home and household products, solar energy, lathes/machining and travel. Tell us your strongest categories; you do not need to be an expert in all of them. Flag technical questions for review rather than inventing claims.



All work must follow Reddit and subreddit rules. No spam, unsolicited bulk DMs, coordinated voting, fabricated experiences, fake reviews or ban evasion. A ban on promotional posts does not permit promotion through comments or private messages. Off-platform follow-up must be consensual and permitted.



HOW TO APPLY

Start with REDDIT-SALES and give short, specific answers:

1. Share one or two Reddit sales campaigns: product/category, dates, verified order results, tracking method and your own contribution. Include redacted proof; clearly label any newly created samples.

2. Link two or three posts/comments you personally created or operated. Briefly explain the relevant community rules and one practical campaign approach for a relevant category.

3. Confirm that USD 2–5 per verified, attributable order works for you. Share your availability, strongest categories and whether you prefer company-provided accounts or your own approved accounts; either option is welcome.



No customer personal data, account credentials or confidential client information in applications.

title: Inside Sales Agent
description:
Inside Sales Agent (ISA) - BuildSignals



ABOUT BUILDSIGNALS

BuildSignals is a pay-per-appointment marketing agency for bathroom remodelers. We run Meta ads for remodeling companies, then call, qualify and book every homeowner lead into an in-home appointment on our clients' calendars.



Our clients only pay for appointments that actually sit, so the ISA is the engine of the business. Every lead you call is money our client already spent, and every appointment you set and confirm is how we get paid.



ROLE OVERVIEW

The Inside Sales Agent (ISA) is the voice of our clients to their homeowner leads. You call every inbound lead fast, qualify them, book them into in-home appointments, confirm those appointments so they show, and handle any customer service the lead needs along the way.



You are also a point of contact for our contractor clients: keeping them updated on appointments, passing along homeowner details, and flagging problems early. You own the CRM, so every lead has a clear status, notes and next step. This is a remote, phone-heavy role for someone who likes talking to people and hates leaving a lead untouched.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Speed to lead and outbound calling

- Call every new inbound lead within 5 minutes of it coming in, on behalf of the client's brand. This applies to every lead from 8am to 8pm in the lead's local time zone, Pacific through Eastern. Anything slower is not accepted.

- Follow the lead follow-up cadence (calls, texts, voi
s) until the lead is booked, disqualified or marked dead

- Work aged and no-show leads through reactivation calls and texts



Qualifying and booking appointments

- Qualify every homeowner on ownership, project type, budget, timeline and decision-makers

- Book qualified homeowners into the client's calendar for an in-home estimate, matching each client's service area and availability

- Make sure every decision-maker (both spouses, co-owners) will be at the appointment. No one-legged appointments.

- Set clear expectations with the homeowner on what happens at the appointment and how long it takes



Confirmations and show rate

- Confirm every appointment by call and text the day before and the day of

- Reschedule cancellations right away instead of letting them drop

- Keep texts short and personal, like a real person texting, not an automated system



Lead customer service

- Answer homeowner questions about the client's services, process and next steps

- Handle inbound calls and texts from leads, including reschedules, follow-up questions and complaints

- Escalate anything outside your scope (pricing, contracts, job issues) to the client or management quickly and politely



Client communication

- Send clients appointment details before each appointment: homeowner name, address, project, budget and notes from the call

- Get the outcome of every appointment from the client (sat, sold, no-show, rescheduled) and log it

- Flag quality issues, calendar gaps or service area problems to management before they become client complaints

- Keep a professional, reliable tone. Clients should feel like you are part of their team.



CRM organization and management

- Keep every lead in the right pipeline and stage in GoHighLevel, with call notes and a next step

- Log every call, text, booking, confirmation and outcome the same day

- Tag disqualified leads with the reason (renter, no budget, out of area, bad number) so we can improve ad targeting

- Keep calendars, pipelines and contact records clean, with no duplicates or stale leads



Reporting and improvement

- Send a short end-of-day report: leads called, contacted, booked, confirmed, and anything management needs to know

- Share patterns you hear on calls (common objections, lead quality, ad questions) so we can improve ads and scripts

- Follow BuildSignals scripts and SOPs, and suggest improvements based on what works on the phone



WHAT COUNTS AS A SAT APPOINTMENT

Every booking is held to this standard. It must have all four:

1. The person is the homeowner

2. Every decision-maker is present

3. The budget is confirmed and fits the project

4. The appointment is held in the home and actually happens



HOW PERFORMANCE IS MEASURED

- Sat appointments: appointments that meet all four sat criteria

- Show rate: 70%+ of booked appointments actually sit

- Speed to lead: under 5 minutes on every lead, 8am to 8pm local time. No exceptions.

- Contact rate: 60%+ of leads reached by phone

- Booking rate: 30%+ of contacted leads booked

- CRM accuracy: 100% of leads with correct stage, notes and next step, same day

- Client feedback: no unresolved complaints on appointment quality or communication



TOOLS YOU WILL USE

- GoHighLevel (GHL): CRM, pipelines, calendars, calling, texting and automations

- Client portal and funnel dashboard: where clients see their leads and appointments

- Phone and SMS: calling and texting leads under each client's brand

- Google Workspace and Slack or text: internal communication



Experience with GHL is a big plus. We train on everything else.



REQUIREMENTS

- 1+ year in appointment setting, inside sales, call center or customer service

- Comfortable making 100+ calls a day and talking to homeowners all day

- Fluent, clear English on the phone and in writing

- Organized and detail-oriented: you log everything and never lose track of a lead

- Reliable, fast internet, a quiet workspace and a headset

- Available to cover lead hours of 8am to 8pm local time across Pacific to Eastern time zones, including some Saturdays

- Coachable: you follow scripts and SOPs and take feedback well



NICE TO HAVE

- Basic contracting or construction experience, or time in home improvement, remodeling or another home-services industry

- GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience

- Bilingual English and Spanish

- Familiarity with NEPQ or other consultative sales frameworks



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Location: Remote

- Schedule: Full-time

- Pay: $1,000 per month base, plus a bonus on every appointment you book (OTE
)

- Growth: As BuildSignals adds clients, strong ISAs can grow into lead ISA, team trainer or client success roles



HOW TO APPLY

Every applicant must send a Loom video or voice recording (about 60 seconds) introducing yourself as if you were calling a homeowner about their bathroom remodel request. Applications without a Loom or voice recording will not be considered. We hire on how you sound on the phone.

title: Proven GoHighLevel + Automation Operator (Paid Client Builds Only)
description:
Please read this first: we only interview people who have already built GoHighLevel or automation systems for paying clients, and who can show one live in an interview. Demos, practice builds and course projects are great for learning, but they will not get you through this process.



ABOUT US

Advisor AI Solutions (AAIS) builds AI systems and automation for architecture, engineering and green building firms in Canada and the US. We also run a podcast and content program for the industry. We are a small team based in Alberta, and this role works directly with the founder.



THE ROLE

You will own a large share of client delivery: GoHighLevel builds, automations, AI tools and the reporting that goes with them. We want someone who delivers better than we could ourselves, spots a weak process, fixes it and tells us what changed. This is not an order-taker role.



MUST-HAVES

- At least 2 paid client builds in GoHighLevel and/or Make, Zapier or n8n that you shipped and that are still running (or ran for months). Built for a paying client, not for yourself.

- Willing to screen-share a live client account you built during the interview (workflows, triggers, pipelines). Hide anything private; we want to see the logic.

- Fluent spoken and written English. You will join client calls.

- Firm daily overlap with Mountain Time (Calgary): online 9 AM to 12 PM MT, Monday to Friday, every week. More overlap is welcome; less is a no.

- 25 to 40 hours per week.



NICE-TO-HAVES

- AI agents: n8n agents, voice or chat agents running for a real client.

- Outbound prospecting and list building: Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay.

- Meta ads you set up and ran, with cost per lead.

- Content repurposing and podcast editing (Riverside or similar): clips, captions, show notes.

- Work with professional services firms (architecture, engineering, construction).



PAY AND CONTRACT

- Monthly pay: USD 800 to 1,200 per month, based on proven work. Please quote a monthly rate in USD.

- Weekly hour cap agreed up front.

- Tell us how many active clients you have now and how many hours a week each takes. We check this against your profile, so please be accurate. Other clients are fine; surprises are not.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here by following these steps. We read every application that follows them and skip the rest.

1. Start your application with the word SHIPPED.

2. Link or describe 2 paid client builds. For each: the client type, what you built, the tools, and the result it drove (for example leads, booked calls, hours saved).

3. State your exact daily overlap window in Mountain Time.

4. State your monthly rate in USD.

5. State your current active clients and the hours you give each.

6. Answer the screening questions in your own words. Short and specific beats long and polished. We can tell when answers are written by AI or read from a script.



Include a Loom showing a live client GoHighLevel account you built (paid client work only).



HIRING PROCESS

1. Short screen (15 minutes): rate, hours, overlap, client load.

2. Live screen-share interview (30 minutes): you walk us through a live client build and we ask how it works and what broke.

3. Paid trial task (2 to 3 hours, paid pro rata at your agreed monthly rate, no client data).

4. Decision within a week of the trial.



Target start: early November 2026.



SCREENING QUESTIONS (answer these in your application)

1. Describe 2 paid client builds in GoHighLevel, Make, Zapier or n8n that are live today or ran for months. For each: client type, what you built, the contract size in USD, and one measurable result (for example leads, booked calls, hours saved). If you have fewer than 2, say so.

2. Pick one of those builds. What broke after it went live, how did you find out, and exactly what did you change in the workflow to fix it?

3. In the interview you will screen-share a live client account you built. Which account will you show (client type only), and what will we see in it: which workflows, triggers, pipelines or integrations?

4. What are your exact working hours, Monday to Friday, in your time zone and in Mountain Time? Confirm you can be online 9 AM to 12 PM MT every weekday.

5. What is your monthly rate in USD, how many hours a week can you give us, and how many active clients do you have right now (with hours per week for each)?

ProxMedia is an AI marketing agency based in Denver, Colorado. We work with service businesses in the US: HVAC, plumbing, roofing and clinics. We set up the AI that answers their phone when they're on a job, run their

You call business owners in the US and book them onto a 20-minute call with our founder. That's it. You won't close or quote prices. You find out if they have a problem we can fix, and if they do, you put a time on the calendar.

- Use our script, and know it well enough that it doesn't sound like a script

- Log every call in our CRM: outcome, notes, next follow-up date

SCHEDULE

YOU'RE A FIT IF

- You've done outbound calling or appointment setting for US clients before (tell us the niche)

- Your spoken English is clear and natural, and a contractor in Texas won't have trouble understanding you

- "No" doesn't ruin your night. Most calls end in a no, and that's normal

- You have a quiet place to work, a headset, and stable internet with a backup



TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "Driveway" so we know you read this.

Then send:

title: Part-Time 2D Animator / Video Editor (Paper Cutout Style) – Faceless Finance YouTube Channel
description:
I'm launching The Money Desk, a faceless YouTube channel that explains the economy, housing, debt and the stock market in simple terms. I'm looking for a long-term part-time animator / video editor to create 10-12 minute videos in a specific paper-cutout style. This can grow into a full-time role as the channel grows.



THE STYLE

- Paper cutout animation (similar to the construction-paper look of South Park), using our own original characters

- Everything sits on a lined school-paper background

- Cutouts move in choppy, stop-motion steps (about 12 fps)

- Real charts and article screenshots are "taped" onto the paper, with highlighter, red-marker circles and cutout arrows

- Big numbers are made of "money papier-mache" letters (textures provided)

- Transition: the scene crumples into a ball of money and gets tossed away, revealing the next scene, with a paper-crunch sound effect



A style guide with example frames will be sent to shortlisted applicants.



WHAT I PROVIDE

- Script and finished voiceover for every video

- Logo, intro, money textures, style guide and all brand assets

- The charts and screenshots to use, with sources



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Animate about 4 videos per month (10-12 minutes each) to match the voiceover

- Build and reuse a library of cutout characters and props

- Add music, sound effects and on-screen text

- Deliver a first cut within 5 days, with one round of revisions per video



REQUIREMENTS

- Portfolio with 2D animation, cutout or motion graphics work (links required)

- Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro or similar

- Good English for reading scripts and notes

- Reliable internet and meeting deadlines

- All artwork must be original. The channel owns all assets and videos.



PAY AND TRIAL

- $450-$600 USD per month depending on skill, paid twice a month

- Shortlisted applicants complete a paid test: a 75-second scene, paid $40



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "MONEY DESK" and include:

1. 2-3 links to your animation work

2. The software you use

3. Your expected monthly salary



Applications without portfolio links will not be considered.

, SMS, and voi

title: News Writing Assistant
description:
News Writing Assistant



Remote | Philippines | Paid trial



Pay: $600 a month



Hours: Monday to Friday, 7am to 3pm UK time (3pm to 11pm Philippine time).



Start: early to mid-November 2026



About us



We’re a UK news agency. We supply stories, photos and video to major news websites.



We need a careful writer for one task: turning a story our editors have chosen into a short news draft, using our template and AI tools.



For every story:



What we give you



1. The story, chosen by our news team

2. The source links, pictures and video

3. Our template, style guide and example stories

4. The AI and translation tools you need



What you do



1. Read everything in the package. Translate it with our tools where needed.

2. Write a short article draft in our template, with help from AI.

3. Check the draft against our accuracy checklist:

   1. Every name, date, place, number and quote matches the sources.

   2. The headline and story should only describe what the pictures or video actually show.

   3. For live stories, such as disasters or accidents, a quick search shows if numbers like the death toll have changed. Update the number and add a link to the new source so the editor can verify it.

4. Send the draft to the editor and list anything you’re unsure about.

5. An editor reviews every draft before it goes out and will ask questions if they arise.



Important: If sources disagree or something can’t be checked, never guess. Always flag it to an editor.



The day



1. 7 to 11am UK is the busiest time. Deadlines are tight and articles need to be written and checked quickly.

2. After 11am, you’ll help the team and learn new tasks.

3. Once you’re fully trained, the aim is to write five drafts a day.



What we’re looking for



1. Excellent written English

2. Careful reading. You notice when something doesn’t add up.

3. You ask when you’re not sure.

4. Quick, reliable replies on Slack



You don’t need to be a journalist. Writing, editing or research experience helps. You’ll show us your skills in the paid assessment.



You’ll need



1. Your own laptop

2. A reliable internet connection



If a storm, power cut or connection problem stops you working, tell your editor as soon as you can.



Sensitive material



Stories often involve crime, violence, accidents and deaths. Some pictures and video may be distressing. Only apply if you’re comfortable with this.



How to apply



1. Subject line: News Writing Assistant – [Your Full Name]

2. In around 150 words, in your own words, tell us:

   1. Your writing, editing or research experience

   2. Whether you can work 7am to 3pm UK time, Monday to Friday, and when you could start

   3. One thing you’d check before trusting a news story written by AI

3. If you have one, include an example of your writing or research. Say what you did, and whether you used AI.

4. You must end your application with the phrase “Checked and ready to file”.



What happens next



1. Paid assessment: shortlisted applicants get an AI-written article draft to check and correct against the sources. We’ll confirm the fee and time allowed before you start.

2. Paid pilot: successful applicants may be offered a limited paid pilot.

3. Regular work: if the pilot goes well for both sides, we’ll agree ongoing work.



We’ll assess:



- Your accuracy against the sources

- Your written English and use of the template and AI tool

- Whether you flag what’s unclear

- Your speed

- How much editing your draft needs

title: NDIS HR & Compliance Coordinator
description:

This is a hands-on role for someone who is confident managing sensitive employee matters, coordinating performance management processes, and ensuring HR and compliance tasks are completed within required timeframes.

Key Responsibilities

Liaise with relevant insurers, claims managers, and other stakeholders.

Maintain the workers' compensation register and monitor outstanding actions.

Ensure claims and related documentation are accurately recorded and followed up.

Assist with coordinating workplace i
-related HR actions where required.

Maintain accurate HR and compliance tracking registers.

Monitor outstanding actions, deadlines, and employee documentation.

Provide regular updates to the General Manager on open HR matters and compliance requirements.

Identify gaps, follow up proactively, and ensure actions are completed within required timeframes.

Support continuous improvement of HR administration and workforce compliance processes.

Key Performance Expectations

Proactively identify outstanding tasks and act without waiting for repeated instructions.

Maintain accurate records and ensure deadlines are met.

Confidently coordinate employee performance and disciplinary processes.

Monitor workforce compliance requirements relevant to NDIS operations.

About You



We are looking for someone with experience in HR coordination, employee relations, and compliance administration, ideally within the NDIS, disability support, aged care, or another regulated care environment.

Experience in HR coordination, HR administration, or employee relations.

Experience maintaining employee records, compliance registers, and supporting documentation.

Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.

A proactive, solutions-focused approach.

The ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgement.

The ideal candidate can identify an issue, determine the next steps, take action, follow up with the relevant people, and keep the General Manager informed without requiring constant reminders.

title: ESTIMATOR – PLANSWIFT MATERIAL TAKE-OFFS
description:
OneWorld Business Solutions is a premier accounting firm based in Perth, WA, specialising in Accounting, Marketing and CFO services. We aim to empower businesses with back-end support to create a sustainable business. 



We are looking for an experienced Estimator to support one of our clients in the construction industry, to complete material take-offs for:



• Wall Partitions

• External Fibre Cement Cladding

• Metal Deck Roofing

• Internal Ceilings



What you’ll do



Review Project Documentation

• Review architectural plans, structural drawings, elevations, sections, details, schedules and specifications.

• Confirm latest drawing revisions are being used.

• Identify system types, construction requirements, materials and finishes.

• Review acoustic, fire-rated, moisture-resistant, weatherproofing and specialty system requirements where specified.

• Coordinate with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical and hydraulic drawings.



PlanSwift Setup

• Import and calibrate drawings using known dimensions.

• Organise drawings by level, discipline, elevation, building zone, roof area and system type.

• Create assemblies/templates for each wall type, cladding type, roof sheeting profile and ceiling system.

• Establish naming conventions and colour coding for take-offs.



Wall Partitions

• Measure internal partition wall lengths, heights and wall face areas by wall type.

• Quantify metal studs, top and bottom tracks, deflection head tracks, noggings, bridging and backing support.

• Quantify plasterboard, specialty boards, bulkhead framing and lining requirements.

• Quantify acoustic and fire insulation by thickness and density.

• Count door openings and identify door frame support requirements.

• Review service penetrations and allow for framing modifications where required.

• Quantify fixings, jointing materials and sealants.



External Fibre Cement Cladding

• Measure external wall areas by elevation, cladding type and building level where required.

• Measure feature walls, soffits and external ceilings separately.

• Quantify fibre cement sheets and panels by thickness, size, product type and manufacturer specification.

• Apply waste factors based on panel layout and cutting complexity.

• Quantify top hats, battens, support framing, brackets and clips.

• Quantify sarking, membranes, cavity components and fire barriers.

• Measure openings, penetrations, flashings, trims, jointing systems, sealants and coating areas.

• Identify compliant wall build-ups and quantify components required for fire-rated systems.



Metal Deck Roofing

• Measure roof areas by roof type and sheeting profile, accounting for roof pitch.

• Quantify roof sheeting by profile, gauge, coating and finish.

• Allow for side laps, end laps and project-specific waste allowances.

• Identify standard and custom sheet lengths.

• Quantify battens, purlins, bridging, bracing and secondary steel supports.

• Quantify insulation, sarking and vapour barriers.

• Measure flashings, cappings, gutters and downpipes.

• Quantify rainwater heads, sumps, overflow provisions, roof penetrations, roof openings, fixings and accessories.

• Review roof safety requirements.



Internal Ceilings

• Measure ceiling areas by ceiling type and identify differing ceiling heights.

• Quantify ceiling grids, suspension components, tiles, panels and plasterboard linings.

• Measure bulkheads, soffits and feature ceiling elements.

• Quantify framing, additional supports and insulation.

• Count and classify openings, service penetrations and access panels.

• Quantify trims, movement joints, specialty accessories, consumables and fixings.



Coordination and Quality Assurance Review

• Cross-check quantities against plans, elevations, sections and schedules.

• Verify wall, cladding, roof sheeting and ceiling type allocations.

• Review omissions, overlaps, openings, penetrations and interfaces.

• Check framing calculations, flashing lengths, waste allowances and material assumptions.

• Confirm quantities align with project specifications.

• Audit take-offs within PlanSwift before exporting reports.



Deliverables

• PlanSwift marked-up drawings and elevations.

• Wall length, cladding area, roof sheeting quantity and ceiling area reports.

• Framing, support framing, grid system, plasterboard, insulation, sarking and membrane quantities.

• Fibre cement panel and ceiling tile/panel schedules.

• Flashing, capping, trim, jointing and sealant schedules.

• Opening, penetration and access panel schedules.

• Gutter and downpipe quantities.

• Bulkhead and soffit quantities.

• Roof safety system schedule.

• Material summary spreadsheet for pricing.

• Assumptions, exclusions, and qualifications register.



Requirements

• Construction take-off/estimating experience, with commercial projects strongly preferred

• Proficient in PlanSwift for material take-offs, marked-up drawings and quantity reports

• Hands-on take-off experience in at least two of: metal roofing, fibre cement/façade cladding, suspended/plasterboard ceilings, steel stud partitions

• Has background in reading Australian drawings and specs. Familiarity with the NCC and Australian Standards or Australian suppliers is a big plus

• Excellent attention to details and organisational skills. If you have read this far, kindly include the word “apple” in your application

• Strong Excel skills

• Good written and verbal English



What We Offer:

Full-time, fully remote contractor (day shift).

Competitive salary and benefits package.

Opportunities for professional growth and development.

A supportive, fun, and collaborative work environment.



For individual applicants only who can commit full-time.

Not open for agencies and freelancers handling multiple clients at a time.

title: Senior Business Plan Writer / Strategist & Market Research Analyst
description:
## Senior Business Plan Writer / Strategist & Market Research Analyst

We are seeking a highly skilled, analytical, and detail-driven Proposal & Business Plan Writer to support Live Plan business planning development. 



Position: Business Plan Writer, Business Strategist & Market Research Analyst  

Work Type:** Remote | Long-Term Opportunity  

Experience Required: 5+ Years  

Initial Trial: 1-Week Trial  

Availability: Consistent Monday–Friday availability required  

Experience Level: Advanced / Senior



## POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a highly skilled Business Plan Writer, Business Strategist, and Market Research Analyst to support the development and evaluation of multiple startup and small-business ventures.



This is not a general administrative VA or entry-level research position.



The ideal candidate is an experienced business research professional who can independently conduct credible market research, analyze industries and competitors, develop comprehensive business and feasibility plans, build financial forecasts, and convert research into professional pitch decks and strategic recommendations.



Strong experience with "LivePlan" is highly preferred.



You must be able to move beyond simply collecting information. We need someone who can **analyze the evidence, identify what it means for the business, challenge weak assumptions, and translate research into practical business strategy.**



## PRIMARY ASSIGNMENTS



You will assist with the development of:



**1. LivePlan Business Plans**  

Develop comprehensive business plans using LivePlan, including executive summaries, company descriptions, problems worth solving, solutions, target markets, competitive analysis, marketing activities, sales channels, operations, milestones, financial assumptions, and supporting research.



**2. Feasibility Studies**  

Research and evaluate whether proposed businesses, products, services, and projects are commercially viable before significant capital is committed.



**3. Pitch Decks**  

Develop professional, research-supported presentations that clearly communicate the business opportunity, customer problem, solution, target market, competitive advantage, business model, financial outlook, and growth strategy.



**4. Marketing Pitches & Strategy**  

Develop persuasive marketing strategies and business-development materials supported by target-customer, competitive, pricing, industry, and market research.



**5. Financial Forecast & Budget Planning**  

Assist with startup-cost estimates, operating budgets, sales forecasts, revenue assumptions, expense projections, cash-flow planning, break-even analysis, and financial scenarios.



**6. Market Research Reports**  

Produce detailed market research reports covering market size, industry conditions, consumer demand, customer demographics, competitors, pricing, trends, barriers to entry, opportunities, risks, and market feasibility.



## CORE SKILLS REQUIRED



**Business Plan Writing & Strategy:  Advanced ability to transform a business concept and supporting evidence into a structured, professional, and actionable business plan.



**Market Research & Data Analysis: Strong ability to locate, validate, analyze, and interpret market, industry, consumer, competitor, and economic data.



**Financial Forecasting & Business Modeling: Ability to develop realistic startup budgets, revenue projections, expense forecasts, cash-flow assumptions, break-even calculations, and scenario analyses.



Feasibility & Competitive Analysis: Ability to determine market demand, analyze direct and indirect competitors, identify market gaps, evaluate risks, and assess commercial viability.



Pitch Deck & Executive Presentation Development: Ability to convert detailed research and financial information into concise, persuasive, professional presentations for owners, lenders, partners, investors, or other stakeholders.



## PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES



The selected candidate will independently conduct primary and secondary business research; identify credible data sources; analyze industries, competitors, customers, pricing, and market conditions; and prepare professional written reports supported by verifiable evidence.



You will develop and revise LivePlan business plans, feasibility studies, market research reports, marketing strategies, financial forecasts, budgets, and pitch decks.



Research should prioritize credible sources such as government databases, Census data, SBA resources, economic-development agencies, industry associations, company filings, reputable research organizations, academic resources, and established market-data providers when appropriate.



You will be expected to cite and document important research sources so information can be independently verified.



The role also requires reviewing existing business-plan material, identifying unsupported assumptions or research gaps, recommending improvements, and strengthening the evidence supporting major business decisions.



## CPM / PROJECT & TASK MANAGEMENT — REQUIRED



The selected candidate must be capable of independently organizing assignments and maintaining a structured CPM / project-management system.



At the beginning of each project or workweek, you will create a project schedule identifying assignments, priorities, deliverables, deadlines, research requirements, and project status.



You will be responsible for keeping assigned projects organized, updating progress, meeting agreed deadlines, and providing concise weekly completion reports.



Candidates should be comfortable using tools such as CRM software, LivePlan, Airtable, Clockify, microsoft Excel Sheets, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, or comparable project-management systems.**



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



Applicants must have at least 4+ years of verifiable professional experience in business-plan writing, business research, market research, strategic planning, financial analysis, feasibility analysis, or closely related work.



Candidates must demonstrate strong professional English writing, analytical reasoning, attention to detail, independent research ability, and the ability to work efficiently without constant supervision.



Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets competency is required for financial modeling and research analysis.



Experience with "LivePlan" is strongly preferred. Experience developing professional PowerPoint or Google Slides presentations is also expected.



Applicants must be able to distinguish credible evidence from unsupported internet content and must not submit fabricated statistics, unverifiable citations, or unreviewed AI-generated research as completed professional work.



AI tools may be used to improve efficiency when appropriate, but all research, calculations, sources, conclusions, and deliverables must be independently reviewed and validated by the candidate.



## PORTFOLIO & EXPERIENCE VERIFICATION



Candidates should be prepared to screen-share or provide examples of previous professional work with confidential client information removed or redacted where necessary.



Examples may include:



**Market Research & Data Analysis: Research reports demonstrating your ability to gather reliable market data, identify industry trends, evaluate target markets, and interpret findings.



**Competitive Analysis: Documentation demonstrating your ability to research competitors, evaluate their positioning and strategies, identify market gaps, and uncover potential business opportunities.



**Business Plans: Comprehensive business plans you have written or substantially contributed to, including executive summaries, market analysis, competitive positioning, business models, marketing strategies, and operational plans.



**Feasibility Studies: Work demonstrating your ability to evaluate market demand, competition, startup and operating costs, risks, financial viability, and overall project feasibility.



**Financial Research & Projections: Startup-cost analyses, revenue forecasts, operating budgets, cash-flow projections, break-even analyses, or other financial models supporting business decisions.



**Pitch Decks & Investor Materials: Presentations demonstrating your ability to synthesize complex information into clear and persuasive materials communicating the opportunity, value proposition, market potential, competitive advantage, strategy, and financial outlook.



**Research Sources & Methodology: During the interview, be prepared to explain the databases, government resources, industry reports, research tools, and methodologies you use to locate and validate business information.



1-WEEK TRIAL PERIOD — MANDATORY!



Final candidates must successfully complete a one-week trial period before being considered for Gig position.



The trial will evaluate actual job-related skills and may include a defined research assignment requiring the candidate to conduct market and competitor research, document credible sources, analyze findings, develop a small financial model or forecast, and prepare a concise executive-level report or presentation.



Candidates will be evaluated on research quality, source credibility, analytical depth, accuracy, financial reasoning, writing quality, organization, speed, communication, and ability to meet deadlines.



The trial is intended to verify that demonstrated skills match the candidate's resume, portfolio, and interview.



## HOW TO APPLY — FILTER QUESTIONS REQUIRED



To be considered, begin your application with the words:



**BUSINESS STRATEGY 2026**



Then answer all of the following questions:



1. How many years of professional experience do you have writing business plans and conducting market research?



2. Have you personally built business plans using "LivePlan"? If yes, approximately how many?



3. Describe the most comprehensive market research or feasibility study you have completed and explain what research you personally performed.



4. What sources or databases do you normally use to obtain reliable market size, industry, demographic, competitor, and economic data?



5. Describe your experience creating financial forecasts, startup budgets, cash-flow projections, and break-even analyses.



6. What software do you use for business plans, financial analysis, research, project management, and pitch-deck development?



7. Provide or be prepared to screen-share 2–3 examples of relevant previous work. Confidential client information may be redacted.



8. Explain how you verify market statistics and financial information before including them in a client report or business plan.



9. willing to complete multiple assignments in one-week time period.



10. What is your expected hourly or weekly compensation for a long-term position?



**Applications that do not answer all screening questions or do not include “BUSINESS STRATEGY 2026” at the beginning may not advance to the interview stage.**



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for more than someone who can fill in business-plan templates.



The right candidate should be capable of receiving a business concept, independently determining what research is needed, finding credible evidence, analyzing the opportunity, developing reasonable financial assumptions, identifying weaknesses and risks, and presenting management with a professional and defensible recommendation.



For a candidate who consistently demonstrates excellent research, accuracy, efficiency, communication, and strategic thinking, this position has the potential to develop into a long-term professional role supporting multiple company projects.

title: Marketing Strategist for US Veterinary and Dental Marketing Agency (Team Lead, Full-Time, Night Shift)
description:
About us



Adheft Marketing runs growth marketing for independent veterinary hospitals and dental practices across the US. Our clients do not care about clicks. They care about new clients, visits, average transaction and revenue. We need one person who owns whether those numbers go up.



This is not a media buyer role and not a client-facing account manager role. We already have Google Ads specialists, a project manager and a social team, and you will lead them. We are looking for the person who looks at each client's business, decides what should happen next, directs the team to do it, and checks that it worked.



What you will own



- Results across our client book. When a practice is growing, you know why. When it is flat or slipping, you are the first to see it and the one who fixes it.

- Diagnosis. Is the problem the ads, the website, the front desk not booking calls, the clinic being at capacity, pricing, or seasonality? Often it is not marketing at all. You find the real cause before anyone spends money on it.

- Decisions. You set 3 to 5 priorities per client per month: where budget goes up, where it gets cut, what to test, and what to stop.

- Leading the fulfillment team. You set weekly priorities for our Google Ads, Meta, SEO, web and social people, review their work, catch mistakes before they ship, and coach them so quality keeps improving. You check that the work moved the business numbers, not just that it got done.

- Honest calls. If a client's target is not realistic, you show the math and what can be done. If something we are doing is not working, you say so and change course.



Work schedule



- Full-time, 30+ hours per week, long-term (6+ months, hopefully much longer).

- Fixed schedule: Monday to Friday, 9am to 4pm US Central Time. That is a night shift in the Philippines: about 10pm to 5am Philippine time (11pm to 6am during US winter). Please apply only if this schedule genuinely works for you.



Salary



- $18 to $28 per hour depending on experience (roughly $3,100 to $4,850 per month full-time). Paid hourly through OnlineJobs or your preferred method.



You are probably a fit if you:



- Start with "what is the business trying to do?" before you open an ad account.

- Do not trust a number until you know how it was measured. You know a "conversion" is not the same thing as a new patient.

- Can explain your reasoning in plain English, in a few sentences, to the founder and to the specialists doing the work.

- Have led or directed a team of marketers or specialists, and can give direct feedback on someone's work without being vague or harsh.

- Say "I don't know yet, here's how I'll find out" instead of guessing.

- Follow through without being chased.

- Have solid fundamentals in paid search, paid social, local SEO and Google Business Profile, plus GA4 and call tracking. You do not need to be the best buyer on the team. You need to know enough to direct one and catch bad work.



Nice to have



- Experience with veterinary, dental, medical or other appointment-based local businesses.

- Agency experience across several clients at once.

- Comfortable with ClickUp, CallRail, Google Sheets dashboards, Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.



How we will measure you



Client new-client and revenue trends, client retention, the quality of the team's work, and how rarely the founder has to step in.



How to apply (required)



Applications that skip the screening questions will not be read. Keep answers short. We are reading for how you think, not how much you write.



1. A vet hospital's phone calls from Google Ads are up 20% month over month, but new clients are flat. What are the first three things you check, and why in that order?

2. A dental practice wants to double new patients in 90 days without raising its ad budget. What do you recommend, and why?

3. Describe a time the data pointed one way and you concluded something different. What did you see that others missed?

4. Confirm you can work 9am to 4pm US Central, Monday to Friday. What city and time zone are you in?

title: Probate Lead Researcher
description:
Part-Time Real Estate Research Assistant (Probate Records, Georgia)



About the role

I run a wholesale real estate investment business in metro Atlanta, Georgia, USA. I buy houses from families settling a loved one’s estate. I’m looking for a research assistant to find and verify new probate cases using public court and property records, and to enter qualified leads into a Google Sheet. This is a research role. No phone calls or sales.



What you’ll do



1. Search the Georgia, USA Public Notice website each week for new probate notices in assigned counties (Cobb, Gwinnett, etc).

2. Look up the deceased person on the county Tax Assessor website to confirm they owned a house in their own name.

4. Open the case on the county probate court website to find the personal representative’s name, mailing address and phone number, and check whether they’ve been officially appointed.

4. Enter each qualified lead into our Google Sheet, and log rejected estates (with the reason) on a separate tab.

5. Flag anything unusual in a notes column instead of guessing.



Weekly goal

About 75–100 qualified leads per week after training. We start smaller in the first two weeks if needed. I really just want to see that you care and focus on quality instead of quality.



Requirements



1. Attention to detail. Quality matters more than quantity.

2. Reliable internet and a computer

3. Not scared to communicate when confused. I'll help as much as I can to make sure you are successful!



Hours and pay



20 hours per week, flexible schedule. Work just needs to be done by Friday each week.

$6 per hour, paid weekly via ACH transfer

1% commission on every wholesale assignment fee we get. If we make $30,000 on a deal, you will get $300



How to apply

Send a short message that includes:



1. Your experience with research, data entry or US real estate.

2. Your hours available each week and your time zone.

3. The word “COBB” at the top of your message, so I know you read the full post.

Skills

ABOUT YOU

title: Freelance Construction Estimators – Australian Projects
description:
# Senior Full Build Estimator / Quantity Surveyor

**Freelance | Per Project | 100% Remote**



We are looking for an experienced **Senior Full Build Estimator / Quantity Surveyor** to join our freelance estimating network.



We're specifically looking for someone with extensive hands-on experience estimating **complete Australian construction projects**, from residential builds through to large-scale commercial and industrial developments.



This is not a position for junior estimators or those specialising in only one or two trades. We need someone who can confidently complete detailed takeoffs, apply accurate construction costs and prepare comprehensive estimates across an entire building project with minimal supervision.



### What We're Looking For



We're seeking a senior estimator with proven experience in **full scope building takeoffs and cost estimating**, including:



- Siteworks, excavation and earthworks

- Concrete, footings, slabs and foundations

- Structural steel and structural framing

- Timber framing and carpentry

- Brickwork and blockwork

- Roofing, cladding and facades

- Internal and external wall systems

- Plastering, rendering and painting

- Waterproofing and insulation

- Floor and wall tiling

- Flooring and internal finishes

- Windows, doors and glazing

- Joinery and fitout components

- External works and associated construction packages

- Preliminary costs, labour, materials and subcontractor allowances



You must be confident interpreting architectural, structural and relevant engineering drawings, identifying project requirements and producing accurate, detailed estimates across multiple trades.



### Minimum Requirements



- Minimum 5 years' experience estimating Australian construction projects, preferably in a senior full build estimating role

- Proven experience completing full scope building takeoffs and detailed cost estimates

- Strong understanding of Australian construction methods, materials, labour rates and building practices

- Experience estimating residential, commercial and/or industrial developments

- Ability to prepare detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and trade-by-trade cost breakdowns

- Ability to identify missing information, drawing discrepancies, exclusions and required allowances

- Strong understanding of construction sequencing, material quantities, wastage and labour requirements

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

- Strong written English and communication skills

- Reliable and able to consistently meet project deadlines



**We are specifically seeking someone who has previously estimated complete building projects from start to finish, not just individual trade packages.**



### Software



Experience using professional takeoff and estimating software is essential.



- PlanSwift/Bluebeam/Costx experience is essential

- Must have access to your own licensed copy of your preferred takeoff software

- Strong Excel skills for detailed estimating and cost breakdowns



Please include the software you have used and your level of experience with each.



### The Role



You'll be responsible for reviewing Australian construction documentation, completing comprehensive full build takeoffs and preparing detailed cost estimates.



Responsibilities include:



- Reviewing architectural, structural and relevant engineering plans and specifications

- Completing detailed quantity takeoffs across all relevant building trades

- Preparing itemised Bills of Quantities and cost estimates

- Applying appropriate material, labour, plant and subcontractor costs

- Identifying scope gaps, discrepancies, assumptions and exclusions

- Producing accurate, well-organised estimating reports

- Delivering completed projects within agreed timeframes



### Our Freelance Model



This is **not an employment position**.



Successful applicants will become part of our preferred freelance estimating network and will be offered projects based on their experience and availability.



- Paid on a per-project basis

- No minimum workload

- No maximum workload

- Choose the projects you want to accept

- 100% remote

- Ongoing opportunities for the right estimator



### To Apply



Please include:



- How many years you've been estimating Australian construction projects

- Your experience completing full build takeoffs and cost estimates

- The types of projects you've estimated (residential, commercial, industrial, etc.)

- Typical construction values of projects you've estimated

- Which building trades you can confidently take off and cost

- Your experience preparing Bills of Quantities and detailed cost estimates

- Takeoff and estimating software you've used

- Your availability and typical project turnaround times

- Your CV

- **Examples of previous complete building takeoffs and cost estimates (highly preferred)**



**Please only apply if you have proven experience independently completing full scope building estimates for Australian construction projects.**



We're looking for an experienced professional who can take a complete set of construction drawings and confidently deliver an accurate, comprehensive building estimate without needing to be trained in the fundamentals.

title: VIRTUAL RENTAL OPERATIONS MANAGER & CRM SPECIALIST
description:
# WE'RE HIRING: VIRTUAL RENTAL OPERATIONS MANAGER & CRM SPECIALIST



**Company:** Opio Solutions LLC  

**Industry:** Vehicle Rental / Transportation  

**Location:** Remote  

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  

**Working Hours:** 40 hours per week, aligned with Dallas, Texas (Central Time)  

**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience



## About Our Company



Opio Solutions LLC is a growing Dallas, Texas-based vehicle rental company specializing in providing affordable, reliable vehicles to individuals, including rideshare and delivery drivers.



Our business is expanding, and we are receiving a steady flow of customer inquiries and rental applications through our advertising campaigns.



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, dependable, and results-driven **Virtual Rental Operations Manager** to oversee our daily operations, manage our CRM, coordinate rentals, and deliver excellent customer service.



**We need someone who can take ownership of tasks, solve problems independently, follow up consistently, and keep our operations running smoothly without constant supervision.**



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### 1. Lead Management & CRM Administration

- Monitor incoming leads from
 Ads, website forms, phone calls, SMS, and other marketing channels.

- Respond promptly to new inquiries during working hours.

- Contact potential renters by phone, text,
, and WhatsApp when appropriate.

- Qualify prospects based on our rental requirements.

- Maintain accurate lead information and communication histories in our CRM.

- Track every prospect from initial inquiry through application, approval, payment, and vehicle pickup.

- Follow up consistently with leads who have not completed their applications.

- Reactivate older leads and recover missed rental opportunities.

- Organize leads by status, priority, and next follow-up date.

- Ensure no qualified lead is forgotten or left unattended.



### 2. Rental Applications & Agreement Management

- Guide prospective renters through our online application process.

- Review submitted applications for completeness.

- Follow up on missing information and required documentation.

- Verify that customers have submitted the required insurance documentation for review.

- Prepare rental agreements using approved company templates.

- Send agreements electronically for signature.

- Follow up with renters who have not signed.

- Ensure agreements and required documents are completed before vehicle release.

- Maintain organized digital rental records.

- Escalate unusual applications or concerns to management for approval.



### 3. Payment Tracking & Collections Follow-Up

- Monitor upcoming, outstanding, and overdue rental payments.

- Send payment reminders before due dates.

- Follow up professionally with customers who miss payments.

- Maintain accurate payment records in the rental management system.

- Update payment statuses and reconcile records against the payment platform.

- Notify management of overdue accounts, disputes, or unusual payment activity.

- Follow approved company procedures for late-payment escalation.

- Help reduce late payments and improve consistent weekly rental collections.



### 4. Vehicle Maintenance & Fleet Coordination

- Maintain an updated inventory of all company vehicles.

- Track vehicle assignments, availability, mileage, and rental status.

- Monitor scheduled maintenance, including oil changes, tire inspections, brakes, and routine servicing.

- Coordinate with mechanics, mobile service providers, and detailing companies.

- Schedule maintenance appointments and confirm completion.

- Obtain repair estimates and submit them for management approval.

- Follow up on vehicle breakdowns and repair progress.

- Track registration, insurance, inspection requirements, and renewal dates.

- Maintain maintenance histories and records of expenses.

- Coordinate vehicle cleaning and preparation between rentals.

- Help minimize vehicle downtime.



### 5. Customer Service & Renter Support

- Serve as the primary point of contact for existing renters.

- Respond professionally to customer questions, complaints, and service requests.

- Assist renters experiencing vehicle problems.

- Coordinate approved roadside assistance, towing, mechanics, or other support services.

- Handle rental extension requests and scheduling changes.

- Explain rental policies and payment expectations clearly.

- Follow up with customers after resolving issues.

- Escalate accidents, safety concerns, insurance matters, and serious complaints immediately.

- Maintain positive customer relationships and encourage renewals.



### 6. Rental Scheduling & Vehicle Pickup Coordination

- Manage vehicle availability and booking calendars.

- Schedule pickup and return appointments.

- Coordinate appointments with management or authorized local representatives.

- Confirm customers have completed their applications, agreements, and required payments before pickup.

- Send pickup instructions and appointment reminders.

- Track vehicle returns, extensions, and upcoming availability.

- Prevent scheduling conflicts and double bookings.



### 7. Administrative & Operational Management

- Manage the company
 inbox and rental inquiries.

- Organize digital files, customer records, signed agreements, and receipts.

- Maintain accurate operational spreadsheets and reports.

- Track business expenses related to vehicles and rental operations.

- Coordinate with mechanics, vendors, insurers, and other service providers.

- Document customer complaints, vehicle incidents, and resolutions.

- Identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.

- Create and maintain standard operating procedures for recurring tasks.

- Keep management informed about urgent issues while independently handling routine matters.



### 8. Sales Follow-Up & Rental Conversion

- Convert qualified leads into paying renters.

- Follow up persistently but professionally with interested customers.

- Respond to price objections and customer concerns using approved scripts.

- Clearly communicate the benefits of renting from Opio Solutions LLC.

- Follow up on incomplete applications and unsigned agreements.

- Track lost leads and identify reasons prospects do not complete rentals.

- Suggest improvements to customer communication and the rental process.



### 9. Daily Reporting & Performance Tracking



Submit a structured daily operations report covering:



- New leads received.

- Leads contacted and follow-ups completed.

- Applications received, pending, and approved.

- Rental agreements sent and signed.

- New bookings and vehicle pickups scheduled.

- Payments received, upcoming, and overdue.

- Available, rented, and out-of-service vehicles.

- Maintenance scheduled, in progress, and completed.

- Customer complaints and unresolved issues.

- Important priorities for the following day.



Provide a weekly summary of rental performance, outstanding payments, lead conversion rates, fleet utilization, and operational challenges.

- Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Operations Coordinator, Customer Service Representative, CRM Specialist, or Rental Operations Manager.

- Strong experience managing CRM systems and customer pipelines.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Comfortable making and receiving customer calls.

- Experience with
, SMS, online forms, electronic signatures, and payment tracking platforms.

- Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.

- Strong problem-solving skills.

- Comfortable handling multiple customers and urgent requests simultaneously.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet professional workspace.

- Availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.



## PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Experience in vehicle rental, fleet management, transportation, or rideshare businesses.

- Experience with automated CRM workflows.

- Familiarity with
 lead generation and lead-management systems.

- Experience using electronic signature platforms.

- Familiarity with rental management software.

- Experience coordinating vehicle repairs, servicing, and roadside assistance.

- Knowledge of customer retention and payment follow-up procedures.



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We expect our Rental Operations Manager to:



1. Respond promptly to incoming leads.

2. Maintain organized and accurate customer records.

3. Consistently follow up on incomplete applications and agreements.

4. Increase the number of leads converted into paying renters.

5. Ensure payment reminders and overdue follow-ups happen on time.

6. Keep rental vehicles properly scheduled and maintained.

7. Resolve routine customer problems without unnecessary management involvement.

8. Keep management informed without requiring constant supervision.

9. Maintain a reliable, organized, and efficient rental operation.



## IMPORTANT: WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



**We are NOT looking for someone who simply waits for instructions.**



We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through, pays attention to details, and takes responsibility for the daily operations of the business.



You must be comfortable taking ownership of the rental process from the moment a customer submits an inquiry until the rental is completed.



We value reliability, accountability, honesty, excellent communication, and the ability to get things done.

3. Any experience in vehicle rentals, customer service, sales, or fleet management.

4. Your availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.

5. Your expected monthly compensation.

6. A short voice introduction demonstrating your spoken English.



**Important:** Begin your application with the words **"Opio Rental Operations"** so we know you read the entire job description.



We are looking to hire someone dependable who can grow with our company as our fleet and customer base expand.

title: Growth & Operations Manager — Real Estate Wholesaling
description:
GROWTH & OPERATIONS MANAGER — REAL ESTATE WHOLESALING (HOUSTON LAUNCH)



We're launching a lean real estate wholesaling operation in the Houston, Texas market and need an experienced, hands-on operator to build and manage the business from seller lead generation through closing.



Your initial objective is to establish a working operation and drive execution toward our first closed deal. From there, you'll improve the process and help build consistent, profitable deal flow.



THIS IS A BUILDER-AND-OPERATOR ROLE. You must have personally managed wholesaling workflows, teams, and transactions — not only studied the business or sold coaching about it.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Build a practical 14-day launch plan with a budget, weekly priorities, activity targets, and hiring milestones.

Help define target areas, property criteria, lead sources, and deal-review standards.

Set up the CRM, pipeline stages, lead routing, follow-up reminders, automation, scripts, and SOPs.

Launch and manage initial lead-generation efforts.

Recruit, train, and manage callers, VAs, and other staff as workload and results justify hiring.

Ensure seller leads receive timely contact, qualification, follow-up, and documented next steps.

Support acquisitions: property research, comparable sales, repair assumptions, offer prep, and seller follow-up.

Build a qualified local buyer database and manage the dispositions workflow.

Keep contracts, deadlines, and buyer requirements organized and moving up to the point of handoff.

Report weekly on performance, spending, pipeline movement, obstacles, and corrective actions.

Hand signed contract deals off to the owner; the owner coordinates with the title company and attorney to close.



At launch, expect to execute core tasks personally. You'll identify what to delegate, document the process, and manage the people doing the work.



YOUR FIRST MILESTONE — BUILD THE SYSTEM Build and activate a complete acquisition-to-handoff workflow:



A defined market, buy box, and approved launch budget.

A functioning CRM with clear ownership and follow-up standards.

An active, measurable seller lead-generation process.

A documented qualification, deal-analysis, and offer-review process.

A buyer outreach and dispositions process.

A transaction checklist covering contract through handoff to the owner.

A weekly dashboard showing activity, costs, conversion, and next actions.



We expect disciplined execution toward the first closing. Targets and timelines will reflect the starting resources, market conditions, and actual pipeline — we will not invent performance numbers before reviewing the business.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Direct experience building or managing a real estate wholesaling operation.

Demonstrated involvement in transactions that reached closing.

Working knowledge of seller outreach, acquisitions, deal analysis, dispositions, and transaction coordination.

Experience implementing CRMs, follow-up systems, SOPs, and reporting.

Ability to recruit, coach, and hold team members accountable.

Sound judgment about property values, repair assumptions, spending, and escalation.

Familiarity with Houston / Greater Houston is strongly preferred.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



Launch milestones completed and systems actively used.

Qualified seller conversations and consistent follow-up.

Offers, contracts, and movement through the pipeline.

Lead-to-contract and contract-to-close conversion.

Buyer engagement and successful dispositions.

Marketing cost per contract and per closed deal.

Closed assignment revenue and operating profitability.

Accurate records, timely coordination, and clear reporting.



OWNERSHIP & DECISION-MAKING You own daily execution, team accountability, and pipeline management. The owner approves budgets, major hires, offer authority, and material business commitments. We'll set clear decision boundaries at the start.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS



Describe a wholesaling operation you helped build or manage. What did you personally own?

How many deals did it close monthly, over what period, and with what team and marketing budget?

Which lead sources produced closed deals? How did you measure their performance?

What would you investigate before choosing a Houston launch strategy?

What would you personally execute during your first two weeks?

Share a redacted pipeline, weekly report, SOP, or other relevant work sample.

Describe a deal that fell apart and what you changed afterward.

Provide your availability, proposed compensation, and any resources you would need.



REQUIRED: VIDEO OR AUDIO RECORDING Along with your written answers, include a 3–5 minute video OR audio recording (Loom, screen recording, or voice note) walking us through your answers to questions 1, 2, and 7 — the operation you owned, your deal numbers, and a deal that fell apart. Applications without a recording will not be reviewed.



SHORTLIST EXERCISE Shortlisted candidates will review a fictional seller lead and pipeline snapshot to demonstrate qualification, deal review, follow-up, and transaction planning.



Please distinguish your personal results from those of the broader team. We value clear ownership, verifiable experience, and practical execution.

title: AI Workforce Architect & Builder — Build Our Digital Staff and AI Manager
description:
We are hiring an AI Workforce Architect & Builder to design, build, and launch a complete digital staff for our business by December 31, 2026.



Our goal is to create an AI workforce that operates alongside our human team. This includes dedicated agents supporting individual staff members, specialist agents with defined responsibilities, and an AI manager that coordinates work and reports to human leadership.



This is a hands-on role requiring both operational thinking and technical execution. You will take the project from staff interviews through design, implementation, testing, and handover.



What you will build

- An organizational chart defining the AI manager, specialist agents, and their relationships with our human staff.

- Clear roles, responsibilities, permissions, and reporting lines for each agent.

- An AI manager that assigns and routes tasks, tracks progress, checks outputs, and escalates issues requiring human attention.

- Practical assistants tailored to our staff’s actual workflows.

- A straightforward way for staff to assign work, review results, and see what needs attention.

- A reusable foundation that allows us to add or adjust agents without rebuilding the system.



The workforce must be lean, reliable, easy to use, and affordable to operate. We want thoughtful coordination with minimal unnecessary complexity.



Hermes is our preferred framework, ideally deployed on an affordable VPS. You must be able to assess its suitability and explain any technical limitations before implementation.



The three project stages



1. October-  Staff interviews and workforce design

Work with the owner to interview staff, understand their responsibilities, identify repetitive tasks and bottlenecks, and determine where agents can provide meaningful support.

Translate these findings into an operational chart and implementation plan defining agent roles, workflows, integrations, human oversight, operating costs, and acceptance criteria.



2. November - Build and deployment

Build the agreed agents, management structure, and integrations. Establish appropriate access controls, secure credential handling, basic monitoring, backups, and human approval for consequential actions.

Keep the system lightweight, maintainable, and economical, including hosting and AI model usage.



3. December - Testing, refinement, and handover

Test with staff using real tasks. Fix problems, refine workflows, verify coordination between agents, and train staff to use the system confidently.



Deliver complete documentation, deployment instructions, and a working system the business can operate and maintain.

Firm completion deadline.



The agreed scope must be built, tested, documented, and operational by December 31, 2026.

Before accepting the project, you must assess the requirements, confirm your capacity, and commit to an achievable delivery plan within our agreed budget. Once agreed, we expect ownership and follow-through through completion.

Reliability and integrity



Previous contractors have abandoned work without communication. We are looking for someone who honors commitments, communicates honestly, and completes what they agree to deliver.



You must:

- Maintain consistent availability through completion.

- Attend a weekly progress meeting and demonstrate working results.

- Provide brief written updates covering completed work, next steps, and blockers.

- Respond within one agreed business day.

- Flag problems or potential delays early and propose practical solutions.

- Keep all code, configurations, and documentation current in company-controlled accounts throughout the project.

- Complete staff training and a thorough handover.



Required experience



- Building AI agents used for real business operations.

- Designing coordinated agent workflows and manager–specialist structures.

- Translating staff needs into practical systems.

- Working with APIs, integrations, and Linux/VPS deployment.

- Controlling infrastructure and AI usage costs.

- Testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and user training.

We have a limited budget and value practical engineering, clear communication, and dependable delivery.



How to apply
