title: Lead Full Stack Engineer (Internal Tools & AI Automation)
description:
ABOUT US



We’re a growing e-commerce company with Amazon at the core of our business. As we scale, we’re building more of our own internal tools and automations for reporting, advertising, inventory, purchasing, and operations.



We already have a small team building with AI-assisted development, and we’re looking for a senior engineer to bring stronger technical leadership and structure.





ABOUT THE ROLE



You’ll work directly with our CEO to turn business problems and ideas into reliable software.



This is a hands-on role. You’ll help d
 what should be built, design the technical approach, and lead the execution. You’ll also guide a junior teammate using AI tools and make sure what we ship is secure, maintainable, and production-ready.





THINGS YOU MIGHT BUILD



- Amazon SP-API and Ads API integrations

- Dashboards and PPC automation

- Inventory, purchasing, and internal ERP tools

- Workflow automations that reduce manual spreadsheet work

- AI-powered internal tools with review and approval controls





WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Strong foundation in System Architecture; able to design scalable databases, secure API integrations, and robust internal systems from scratch

- Proven Technical Leadership skills, with experience reviewing code, mentoring developers, and establishing engineering best practices

- Strong in TypeScript, React/Next.js and/or Python, plus SQL and Postgres

- Experience building and maintaining production API integrations

- Comfortable working independently and making technical decisions

- Uses AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar, and knows how to verify their output

- Able to take a rough idea, turn it into a plan, and build a working solution





BONUS



- Amazon SP-API or Ads API experience

- Supabase and Vercel

- E-commerce, SaaS, or internal business tools experience





HOW TO APPLY



Please send your CV along with:

1. A short paragraph about a system you were primarily responsible for building that a business relied on daily, and what you’d do differently now.

2. The software/tools you’ve worked with extensively.

3. The AI tools you’ve worked with extensively.

4. Your expected monthly salary in PHP, not hourly.

5. A project, portfolio, or GitHub link, if available.





Applications that don't answer the 5 questions above won't be entertained as it shows you haven't read the whole job description properly. Kindly take note that this is a full-time, WFH role, with a schedule of 9AM to 6PM PH time. You must have your own equipment and backup internet.

title: Airbnb STR Operations Lead (Remote)
description:
About Us



Celeste Stays is a fast-growing US-based luxury short-term rental operator managing a high-end portfolio across Pittsburgh, Cincinnati, Dallas, Cleveland, and Austin across Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking channels.







Our Tech Stack: Hospitable, PriceLabs, Schlage, Blink, Ecobee, Authenticate.com, Minut, Noiseaware, and Zoho Books, backed by a fully documented internal SOP system (~150 pages).







We are scaling rapidly and need a senior, technically-minded operations leader to take full ownership of day-to-day operations. This is NOT a junior VA role. We already have a dedicated junior VA team in place—we are hiring the manager to lead them and optimize our systems.







What You Will Own



Team Leadership (Primary Focus):







Lead, coach, and mentor our remote VA team (currently 3–4 VAs across India and the Philippines).







Run async daily hand-offs, weekly retrospectives, and monthly performance reviews.







Build VA scorecards, track KPIs, handle performance management, and own future VA onboarding.







Revenue Optimization:







Conduct daily PriceLabs reviews: ADR, occupancy, and RevPAR by unit.







Perform gap analysis on the Hospitable calendar and adjust minimum-night settings.







Execute last-minute discounting strategies, special-offer pricing, and stay extensions.







Deliver a weekly revenue report to founders featuring actionable insights, not just raw numbers.







Guest Experience & Inbox Quality:







Quality-check and refine AI-suggested responses (Hospitable Inbox AI) prior to sending.







Manage VIP and repeat-guest communications under a strict 24-hour review response SLA.







Handle complex review dispute appeals (retaliation, content policy, canceled reservations).







Systems, SOPs & Automation:







Maintain and continuously update our ~150-page Company Manual.







Perform quarterly audits of the Hospitable Knowledge Hub across all properties to ensure AI prompt and source accuracy.







Identify automation opportunities (Zapier, Make, n8n, Hospitable rules) to systematically reduce manual work and owner involvement quarter-over-quarter.







Vendor & Operations Coordination:







Ensure multi-city cleaner schedule integrity via city-specific communication channels.







Onboard and coordinate local vendors (handymen, carpet cleaners, hot-tub technicians).







Manage escalations through building management portals (LTV, PoV, Industry, Loft on Pearl, Marshall, Maple).







Reporting & Accountability:







Track weekly KPIs: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR per unit, team scorecards, issue trends, and Aircover/damage claims.







Lead monthly business reviews and present quarterly process-improvement roadmaps.







Issue Triage & Escalation:







Make independent operational decisions using a provided authority matrix.







Escalate critical issues to owners only when necessary—always bringing proposed solutions alongside the problem.







Required Qualifications & Hard Skills



Experience: 5+ years total in operations/VA roles, with at least 3 years directly managing short-term rental / Airbnb operations.







Technical & IT Skills: High technical literacy including API/webhook concepts, advanced spreadsheets (pivots, complex formulas, Apps Script), data visualization (Looker Studio / Google Sheets), workflow automation (Zapier, Make, n8n), and smart-home hardware troubleshooting (Schlage, Ecobee, Blink, Wi-Fi).







Revenue Management: Hands-on experience with PriceLabs (or Beyond / Wheelhouse) with a proven grasp of ADR, occupancy, RevPAR, lead times, and dynamic pricing strategy.







Hospitable Expertise: Advanced proficiency with Hospitable's rules engine, automated messaging, Knowledge Hub, Inbox AI, Suggested Replies, and multi-listing calendars.







OTA Mastery: In-depth knowledge of Airbnb/VRBO listing SEO, review dispute policies, and the complete 9-step Aircover damage claim process.







Communication: Exceptional written English (C1+ / Native level) for high-end US guest interactions.







Work Style: Strong async-first communicator who provides clear status updates and works independently without needing micro-management.







Nice-to-Have Skills



Direct-booking platform management (OwnerRez, StayFi, etc.).







Basic bookkeeping knowledge (Zoho Books, QuickBooks).







Prior experience leading remote teams.







Computer Science, Engineering, or IT certifications.







Guest-screening software experience (e.g., Authenticate.com).







Schedule & Infrastructure Requirements



Hours: 20–40 hours per week (Targeting a long-term full-time commitment).







Time Zone Overlap: Must overlap significantly with US Eastern Time (EST).







Preferred Schedules: ~6:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST (8:30 AM – 1:30 PM EST) OR a split shift (7:00 AM – 10:00 AM IST & 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST).







Setup: Dual-monitor setup preferred, minimum 8GB RAM laptop/PC, stable high-speed internet with power backup, quiet workspace, clear webcam, and professional microphone.







Compensation & Career Growth



Base Rate: $4.00 – $8.00+ USD / hour (commensurate with demonstrated technical proficiency, STR experience, and trial performance).







Mid-level Operations Lead: $4.00 – $6.00 / hr (~₹58,000 – ₹87,000 INR / ₱35,000 – ₱53,000 PHP per month at full-time).







Senior Technical STR Lead: $7.00 – $8.00+ / hr (~₹101,000 – ₹116,000+ INR / ₱61,000 – ₱79,000+ PHP per month at full-time).







Performance Reviews: Structured performance evaluations at 3 and 6 months with clear KPI-driven raise potential.







Long-Term Growth: We seek a 2+ year partner. High performers are promoted internally as our portfolio expands.







Application Requirements (Strictly Enforced)



Note: Incomplete applications will be automatically discarded. We are filtering for detail-oriented, senior-level candidates only.







Please submit the following in your application:







Cover Letter Response: Answer this scenario specifically: "In your last STR or operations role, what was the single biggest operational improvement you designed or implemented? What changed, how did you measure impact, and what were the measurable results after 30, 60, and 90 days?" (Include specific numbers and timeframes).







Tool Proficiency Matrix: Rate yourself from 1 to 5 on each of the following tools, adding a one-line real-world example of how you’ve used them:







Hospitable







PriceLabs







Airbnb (Host-side, Aircover, & disputes)







VRBO







Authenticate.com / Guest Screening







Smart Hardware (Schlage, Ecobee, Blink)







Spreadsheets (Formula complexity ceiling)







Automation (Zapier / Make / n8n)







2-Minute Loom Video (Mandatory):







30-second camera introduction.







90-second screen-share walking through a Hospitable property dashboard you previously managed (blur or anonymize sensitive guest/owner data).







Rate & Availability: State your desired hourly rate (in USD) and weekly hour availability in your cover letter.







Do NOT Apply If:



You are an agency, outsource firm, or plan to subcontract the work.







You do not have hands-on, primary experience managing Airbnb/STR operations.







You cannot or will not record the mandatory Loom video.







You are looking for a short-term gig or side job.







Your written English requires editing or proofreading.







About Working With Us







We are founder-led, fast-moving, systems-obsessed, and heavily leverage AI while maintaining strict quality control. We empower our managers with real authority, value long-term loyalty, and reward performance.

title: Accountant / Bookkeeping
description:
Management Accounting/Bookkeeping Position



Responsible for maintaining clear, current, and reliable financial information for company operations and projects.



Core Responsibilities:



- Maintain accurate bookkeeping records in QuickBooks.

- Manage Accounts Payable and monitor upcoming obligations.

- Manage Accounts Receivable and track customer payment schedules and overdue balances.

- Track payroll and labor costs, including allocation of direct labor to projects when applicable.

- Maintain job costing for every active project.

- Compare estimated, committed, actual, and forecasted project costs.

- Track project revenue, Change Orders, payments received, outstanding balances, gross profit, and gross margin.

- Monitor and categorize company operating expenses, including vehicles, office, software, marketing, and overhead.

- Maintain financial reporting for REMOD GROUP expenses.

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and financial transactions regularly.

- Prepare weekly cash-flow projections and monitor upcoming inflows and outflows.

- Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial projections for management.

- Identify missing, unusual, duplicated, or incorrectly classified transactions and ensure resolution.

- Perform financial closeout of completed projects and confirm final project profitability.

- Provide management with current reports on cash position, A/R, A/P, project profitability, overhead, and company performance.



Primary Objective



Provide management with accurate financial visibility to understand:

- What the company has, what it owes, what it is owed, what each project is costing, how profitable each project is, and what financial obligations and cash needs are coming next.

* Enrich Before Asking: Research the client across internal folders, transcripts, records, and public sources before reaching out so you never ask for known information.

*Qualify via Messaging: Confirm the three gating facts through text/email: Which entity? Which covers? When is it due? (Use phone calls only for stalled files or requested calls).

*Extract Information Conversationally: Gather proposal details using 4–5 plain-language questions per message, using the client's trade language.

*Build & Verify Slips: Complete the quote slip, verify entity details via ABN Lookup, and pass it forward with zero missing data.

*Log & Track Everything: Record every inbound/outbound message verbatim with dates, and diarize renewal dates and follow-ups.

*Cadence Chasing: Follow up on unanswered files systematically, softening document requests or addressing uninsured renewals when files stall.



Core Operating Principles



*Make It Easy: Keep communication short enough that clients can reply from their phones in under a minute.

*Lead with Recognition: Open with a true fact about their business without revealing the source.

*Answer First: Always answer their question before asking yours.

*Bite-Sized Questions: Limit messages to a maximum of 4–5 questions at a time.

*Verify Entities: Double-check CRM names against ABN Lookup every single time.

*Unstick Stalled Files: If paperwork stalls, pivot to a simpler question (e.g., "Just tell me what's coming up and when it renews").

*Revive Dead Renewals: Treat passed renewal dates as urgent opportunities to secure a schedule or discuss being uninsured.

*Reliable Commitments: Never promise what you can't control; always follow through on call-backs the same day.

*Financials & Speed: Group wages and subbies as one figure to prevent omissions, and prioritize speed—same-day service beats cheaper pricing.



Who Fits (Ideal Candidate Profile)



*Exceptional Communication: Writes short, plain, friendly messages tradies can easily read and answer on-site from their phone. Can also hold a confident, natural phone conversation to extract facts without sounding like a questionnaire when needed (phone is part of the role).

*Insurance Knowledge & Quoting Experience: Understands proposal form requirements well enough to ask for details in plain language and spot unusual risks.

*Process Discipline: Strictly follows the playbook without taking shortcuts, logs everything meticulously, and welcomes log reviews.

*Curiosity & Drive: Enjoys digging—knowing that the best files are won in the 10 minutes of research before sending the first message.

description:
Short description



Bizzy is a college app in the US. Students use it for local deals, bar tickets and line skips. Dating is coming soon.



We need a friendly, confident caller to phone small businesses near US college campuses. You will ask restaurants, coffee shops, barbers, salons and boutiques to list a free student deal on Bizzy. It costs them nothing. There is no contract. It is an easy yes for many owners, and you get a bonus every time a deal goes live.



Schedule: about 80 hours a month (about 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday) during US business hours. Most calls happen in the US afternoon, which is late night or early morning in the Philippines.



Markets you will call



- Gainesville, FL (University of Florida)

- Tallahassee, FL (Florida State)

- Athens, GA (University of Georgia)

- Auburn, AL (Auburn University)

- Tuscaloosa, AL (University of Alabama)

- Columbia, MO (University of Missouri)

- Bloomington, IN (Indiana University)



What you will do



- Call independent restaurants, coffee shops, smoothie and boba shops, barbers, salons, nail and tanning shops, and boutiques near campus.

- Start with the businesses closest to the main bar streets. We give you the list and the order.

- Explain Bizzy in under 30 seconds and help the owner or manager pick a simple student deal.

- Collect the deal details: the offer, the days and times, the rules, the contact name and a logo or photo.

- Send a short follow-up text or
 after each call.

- Call back the businesses that asked you to.

- Log every call in our Google Sheet CRM before you finish your shift.

- Make about 20 to 25 calls per calling hour using Quo (our phone app, provided by us).



Requirements



- Clear, easy-to-understand spoken English. You must be comfortable talking with US small business owners.

- A reliable internet connection (at least 10 Mbps) and a backup plan (mobile data or a power bank).

- A quiet place to work and a headset with a microphone.

- Available during US business hours, Monday to Friday, about 4 hours a day. Most calls are from about 2 PM to 6 PM US Eastern time.

- Comfortable with Google Sheets.

- Cold calling or customer service experience is a plus. It is not required if your mock call is strong.



Pay



- Base pay: $5 to $7 per hour, based on experience and your mock call. About 80 hours a month.

- Bonus: $15 for every deal that goes live in the Bizzy app. There is no cap.

- A deal counts once it is live in the app and the business has confirmed it by text or
. We check every one.

- Paid twice a month by Wise or OnlineJobs EasyPay.

- We start with one paid 4-hour trial shift. The best trial caller gets the job.



How to apply



Send all three of these. Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.



1. A short message telling us about any calling, sales or customer service work you have done.

2. Your available hours in US Eastern time.

3. A 60 to 90 second recording of a mock call. Read the mini-script below out loud as if you are calling a real coffee shop. Record it on your phone or computer and send a link (Google Drive, Vocaroo or similar). Make sure the link is public.



Put "Bizzy Deals Caller" in your subject line so we know you read the whole post.



Mini-script for your recording



Hi, is this the owner or manager?



Great. My name is [your name], and I'm calling from Bizzy. It's a student app at the University of Florida.



We help local spots near campus get more students in the door with a student deal. It's completely free to list. There's no contract, and you can change or pause it anytime.



A lot of places do something simple, like 10% off or a free drink with a purchase on slower days.



What do you think would work for you?



Perfect. I'll text you a quick confirmation so you have it in writing. What's the best number or
 for that?



Thanks so much. Have a great day!

title: Industrial Designer / Product Design Engineer – Modular Body Scrubber
description:
** Must apply at: 
 **



We are developing Pebble Scrub, a premium handheld body scrub system inspired by the smooth, organic shape of a river stone.



The product will feature a durable, reusable Pebble body with interchangeable scrubbing attachments, allowing customers to choose different textures and replace attachments while keeping the main body.



We are looking for an experienced Industrial Designer / Product Design Engineer to develop the product through material selection, ergonomic design, mechanical engineering, functional prototyping, and manufacturing preparation.



The goal is a product that feels comfortable, performs well in actual shower use, and can be manufactured at a commercially viable cost.



The product should include:



Reusable Pebble body: A compact, lightweight frame with a premium appearance, comfortable handling, and secure grip with wet, soapy hands. Final material, dimensions, and construction are open to your recommendations.



Interchangeable scrubbing attachments: Potential options include soft silicone, African-net-style exfoliating mesh, and a lathering sponge. Charcoal-containing sponge or textile options may also be explored.



Shared attachment system: A secure, discreet connection that supports different attachment materials and allows easy removal for replacement, rinsing, and drying.



Practical drying/storage solution: A hanging loop or another well-integrated solution.



We have explored an earlier concept and identified several areas requiring improvement: excessive size and weight, overly stiff silicone, and inadequate lathering. These findings will help guide development.



Your responsibilities will include:



Recommend suitable materials and manufacturing processes for the body, attachments, and any attachment carriers or backing components.



Develop the Pebble shape for comfortable use across different adult hand sizes.



Establish target dimensions and weight early, supported by printable sizing models and estimated production weight.



Evaluate attachment mechanisms such as mechanical retention, magnetic attachment, or another practical approach.



Ensure attachments remain secure during wet scrubbing, twisting, and repeated removal. If magnets are proposed, address corrosion protection and secure retention within the product.



Engineer a common connection that works with both molded silicone and textile/sponge attachments.



Develop and compare suitable silicone softness, thickness, and surface patterns through physical samples.



Address lathering, rinsing, drainage, drying, and access for cleaning.



Apply design-for-manufacturing principles, including wall thickness, draft, parting lines, tolerances, assembly, and tooling complexity.



Support prototype evaluation and revisions based on actual use.



Development should follow clear milestones, beginning with the body’s size, handling, material direction, and connection concept.



Early STL files are required so we can print sizing models in-house before detailed engineering proceeds. Functional prototypes should then be used to evaluate weight, wet grip, attachment security, scrubbing feel, and lathering before final manufacturing decisions.



Required deliverables include:



Editable native CAD files for all designed parts and assemblies.



STEP/STP files for manufacturing and supplier review.



STL files for early sizing checks and subsequent prototypes.



Dimensioned drawings with critical interface dimensions and tolerances.



Exploded assembly views and a bill of materials.



Material, surface finish, and manufacturing recommendations.



A prototype/testing plan and documented revisions.



Updated design files following agreed manufacturer DFM feedback.



For textile or sponge attachments, provide appropriate material and assembly specifications alongside CAD for their carriers.



We will provide concept images, reference products, written requirements, feedback from earlier prototype testing, and clear feedback throughout development.



Please include the following in your application:



Two or three relevant physical products you personally designed or engineered. Explain your role and whether they reached manufacturing.



Your CAD software and the editable file formats you can provide.



Your experience with injection-molded plastics, silicone components, and interchangeable attachment systems.



Any experience with personal-care products, wet-use products, or textile/sponge integration.



How you would validate size, weight, and attachment performance early.



Your proposed milestones, availability, and timeline for the first printable sizing models.



Your estimated fees, included revision rounds, and any prototype or supplier coordination services you offer.



This is a project-based opportunity with a flexible budget for the right expertise. Please identify design fees and external prototype/manufacturing expenses separately.



Clear communication, weekly progress updates, and delivery of current CAD files at agreed milestones are essential.

title: Accountant - AU Client
description:
Position Overview:



We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accountant to oversee day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, and Australian tax compliance using Xero. 



The successful candidate will ensure financial records are precise, manage monthly closing cycles, handle Australian Taxation Office (ATO) requirements (such as BAS/IAS, Superannuation, and Single Touch Payroll), and provide actionable financial insights to support company growth.



Key Responsibilities



1. Core Accounting & Xero Management

Oversee daily accounting operations within Xero, ensuring all financial records remain accurate and up to date. Perform/review routine bank reconciliations, process accounts payable and receivable, and ensure accurate GST coding across all transactions. Additionally, maintain Xero integrations with add-on applications to keep financial workflows streamlined.

2. BAS Preparation

Ensure full compliance with Australian Taxation Office (ATO) requirements by accurately preparing, reviewing, and reconciling Business Activity Statements (BAS) and Instalment Activity Statements (IAS). Conduct thorough reviews of General Ledger accounts, GST codes, and PAYG withholding to identify and correct discrepancies prior to submission.

3. Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

Manage the complete month-end closing process, including manual journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and account reconciliations. Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. 

4. Tax & Payroll Compliance

Prepare and lodge Business Activity Statements (BAS) and Instalment Activity Statements (IAS) in compliance with ATO regulations. Process payroll through Xero Payroll, ensuring strict adherence to Single Touch Payroll (STP) rules and timely Superannuation guarantee contributions. 

5. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

Monitor daily cash positions and manage working capital to ensure the business maintains healthy liquidity. Prepare regular cash flow forecasts to track upcoming financial commitments, customer collections, and vendor payments. Provide actionable insights to management regarding cash optimization and financial risk mitigation.



Qualifications & Requirements



Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 

Certification: CA / CPA qualification (or actively working towards certification) is highly preferred. 

Xero Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Xero (Xero Certification is a strong advantage). 

Australian Accounting Knowledge: 3+ years of experience working with Australian accounting standards, GST rules, BAS/IAS filing, STP, and Superannuation requirements.

Technical Skills: Advanced Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling). 

Soft Skills: High attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and excellent written and verbal communication.

title: Part Time AI Animation and YouTube Video Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced creative professional who can turn provided scripts into polished, realistic looking animated videos for our YouTube channel, Smiths Unfiltered.



Our content includes family life, marriage, humor, and everyday situations. We need someone who can bring recurring characters to life through natural movement, facial expressions, dialogue, and engaging scenes.



You should be comfortable managing the entire process from script to finished video with minimal guidance.



What You Will Create



For each assigned script, you will produce:



One complete animated YouTube video, approximately 2 to 3 minutes long, in horizontal 16:9 format.



One YouTube Short created from the strongest moment in that video, in vertical 9:16 format.



Finished videos with clear audio, music, sound effects, and captions where appropriate.



Editable project files and organized character assets so future episodes remain consistent.



We will provide the script, character references, and creative direction. You will handle the visual production and editing.



Responsibilities



Review each script and plan the scenes, character actions, settings, and camera angles.



Create realistic looking animated characters based on provided photos and approved references.



Keep each character’s face, body, voice, and overall appearance consistent throughout the video and across future episodes.



Create natural facial expressions, believable movement, and accurate lip syncing.



Build complete scenes with appropriate backgrounds, lighting, transitions, and camera movement.



Add provided voice recordings or approved AI voices.



Edit dialogue, music, and sound effects so the finished video sounds clear and professional.



Create a Short that has a strong opening and makes sense on its own.



Review all work for distorted faces, hands, unnatural movements, caption errors, and audio problems before submitting.



Make revisions based on feedback and meet agreed deadlines.



Required Experience



Relevant experience in animation, motion design, or video production, including hands on experience with AI animation tools.



A strong portfolio of realistic or semi realistic animated storytelling videos.



Proven experience turning written scripts into complete videos with multiple scenes and speaking characters.



Experience maintaining the same characters across different scenes and episodes.



Strong video editing, sound editing, lip syncing, and visual storytelling skills.



Experience creating both horizontal YouTube videos and vertical YouTube Shorts.



Strong English comprehension and written communication.



Reliable internet and equipment capable of handling video production.



Availability to work part time and consistently meet production deadlines.



You should already know which tools work best for this type of production and be able to explain your process clearly.



The Quality We Expect



We want realistic looking animation with personality, emotion, and smooth storytelling.



A portfolio made mainly of slideshows, stock footage, basic talking avatars, or images with simple zoom effects will not meet the requirements for this role.



The script must stay as provided unless we approve changes. Characters must closely follow the approved references and remain recognizable throughout the video.



What to Include in Your Application:



Three links to your best relevant animation projects. Include at least one video with speaking characters and multiple scenes.



A short explanation of what you personally created in each example.



The animation, AI, voice, and editing tools you use.



Your process for keeping characters consistent across scenes and episodes.



Your estimated turnaround time for one 2 to 3 minute video and one Short.



Your weekly availability for part time work and how many completed video packages you can realistically produce each week.

A quiet workspace, a good headset, main and backup internet, and backup power

Spanish is a bonus

 Short interview, then live mock calls where we play the caller. We check credentials and references. If you’re matched, we train you on HIPAA, our own MVA Certification program, and the clinic’s systems.



To apply

description:

About Point Blank. Point Blank (pointblank.digital) is my DTC growth consultancy. I'm a fractional growth leader for 8-figure ecommerce brands, running several client engagements at once, with 15 years in-house and consulting experience. The business is growing toward a small boutique team, and this is the first hire.

Who thrives here. You've supported a US founder or executive before, you write clean English that doesn't need editing, and you know when to handle something yourself versus when to ask. You'll build the systems with me, not just follow them.



Schedule

• 20 hours/week, Monday–Friday. 3-month initial term, moving to long-term.

• 2–3 hours of live overlap daily with my Pacific Time workday (late evening / night in Manila). We'll set the exact window together; it shifts by one hour when US daylight saving changes.

• Remaining hours are async. My inbox should be triaged and my day prepped before I start.

• Hours can grow as the business adds clients and team members.



What you'll own

 (primary)

• Triage my Gmail daily to zero using a label and priority system we set up together (multiple inboxes across clients)

• Draft replies in my voice for scheduling, vendors, admin and routine client logistics; escalate anything strategic or sensitive

• Track threads waiting on others and follow up so nothing stalls

• Filter and unsubscribe noise; surface priority client threads in a daily summary



Task list (primary)

• Own my master task list: capture to-dos from
, meeting notes and voice memos, with owners, due dates and priority

• Send a start-of-day brief and an end-of-day handoff

• Prep a Friday review: what's overdue, what's due next week, what's waiting on me



Calendar and scheduling

• Manage my calendar across my own and multiple client Google Workspace accounts; avoid double-bookings and protect focus blocks

• Schedule client, vendor and candidate calls across US time zones

• Add context to invites (agenda, links, last notes)



Billing and AR

• Send monthly retainer and project invoices on time

• Track payments and follow up on overdue invoices: polite, firm, documented

• Collect and categorize receipts and expenses monthly for my bookkeeper

• Track contract and renewal dates; flag them 30 days ahead



Personal admin

• Research and compare options for personal needs (travel, services, providers, purchases) and send a short summary with a recommendation; I make the final booking or purchase

• Gather quotes, reviews and availability so decisions take me minutes, not hours

SOPs and systems

• Document every recurring process as you learn it (short Loom + written SOP) in a shared SOP library

• Suggest improvements and automations; we use AI tools heavily and you should too



Growth path (months 3–6)

• Client reporting prep: pulling weekly performance numbers from Shopify, Meta Ads and Triple Whale into existing templates

• Light research and tool or vendor comparisons



Requirements

Must have

• 5+ years as an EA or senior VA, including at least 2 years supporting a US-based founder, executive or consultant

• Experience supporting someone who juggles multiple clients or companies at once

• Excellent written English: drafts I can send with little or no editing

• Advanced Google Workspace: Gmail (labels, filters, templates), Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets

• Hands-on experience with a task or project tool (Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Trello or similar)

• Invoicing and payment follow-up experience

• Daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) for drafting and processing

• Strong judgment on what to handle, what to escalate, and how fast

• Strict confidentiality; you'll see client and financial data and will sign an NDA

• Reliable setup: stable primary internet, backup internet and power, quiet workspace



Nice to have

• Ecommerce, DTC brand or marketing agency background

• Familiarity with Shopify, Meta Ads Manager or Triple Whale

• Basic bookkeeping knowledge

• Experience writing SOPs from scratch



What success looks like at 90 days

• My inbox is at zero daily and I spend under 30 minutes a day in

• Zero missed follow-ups or double-booked meetings

• Invoices go out on schedule and overdue payments are chased without me prompting

• My task list is current every morning, without me maintaining it

• 10+ recurring processes documented as SOPs

• You've started taking on client reporting prep



Compensation and how to apply

Pay. Competitive for a senior EA, paid monthly. Tell me your expected monthly rate for 20 hours/week.



To apply, start your message with the subject line "Point Blank EA – [Your Name]". Applications without it won't be reviewed. 



Include:

1. The US executive you supported longest: their role, how long, and what you fully owned

2. The tools you use daily

3. Your expected monthly rate for 20 hours/week

4. The Pacific Time window you can reliably cover for live overlap

5. A 2-minute Loom introducing yourself and walking through how you'd triage an overloaded inbox



Process

1. Application and Loom review

2. Unpaid trial task (about 1 hour): triage a sample inbox, draft replies, and build a task list from it

3. Reference check with a past US client

4. 30-minute video interview (finalists only)

5. Offer, NDA and onboarding
